Entries.Title: Beauty and Mr. Romantic
Entries.Description: Do Ra comes from a poor family, and they are always on the run as the creditors are chasing after them. On top of that, her mother, Mi Ja, is adamant about making her an actress to earn a living. One day, Do Ra runs into Dae Chung on her way home and falls in love at first sight.

Episodes.Title: Do Ra Meets Dae Chung
Episodes.Description: Do Ra comes from a poor family, and they are always on the run as the creditors are chasing after them. On top of that, her mother, Mi Ja, is adamant about making her an actress to earn a living. One day, Do Ra runs into Dae Chung on her way home and falls in love at first sight.

Episodes.Title: Forced Breakup
Episodes.Description: Sun Young forces Dae Chung and Jung Mi to break up, and Dae Chung loses his temper. As the argument gets out of hand, Geum Ja blurts out the hurtful truth behind Dae Chung's birth in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Mi Ja tries stealing food from Dae Chung's family but gets caught by them.

Episodes.Title: Jun Sub And A Woman
Episodes.Description: Geum Ja witnesses Jun Sub with a woman on the street. She shares the news with Sun Young right away, but Sun Young doesn't believe her words and gets mad at her instead. Meanwhile, Do Ra calls Dae Chung for help, saying she ran into bullies again, so he runs to her to save her.

Episodes.Title: Pil Seung’s New Main Lead
Episodes.Description: Director Jang asks Pil Seung to take his colleague's place and work on the new drama. The moment Pil Seung finds out that Do Ra is the main lead in the drama, Do Ra refuses to take the role to get some rest, and the main investor is about to drop out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Out of spite, Do Ra plans to get back at Bi Bi by flirting with Bong Soo. Pil Seung sees Do Ra making her moves on Bong Soo and is disappointed. Then, out of the blue, Bi Bi comes to the filming set full of rage, and the set turns into chaos.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After telling Hyun Chul that she would help him get the money for the new business he wanted to start, Geum Ja puts on a grim face to meet with Mi Ja. Meanwhile, at the filming site, Pil Seung works his butt off catering to Do Ra and Bong Soo to maintain peace. But Do Ra mistakes his kindness and feels a strange attraction and excitement.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung apologizes to Do Ra for talking behind her back, but she is not willing to forgive him. Furthermore, Myung Dong witnesses how Do Ra treats Pil Seung on set and is about to let the family know about it. Meanwhile, Jin Dan meets Mi Ja and asks her to set him up with Do Ra.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After Do Ra realizes Pil Seung is Dae Chung, her childhood crush, she makes up with him. Mi Ja is determined to marry Do Ra off to Jin Dan, so she sets them up for a date. However, Do Ra only feels uncomfortable around him. Meanwhile, Do Ra and Pil Seung travel to an island for the drama shoot.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: After Dae Sook finds out about Soo Yeon's past, she asks Madam Cho to reveal the truth to Jin Taek as well. Do Ra and Pil Seung safely return home, but Do Ra can't stop thinking about Pil Seung, just like back when she was 12. Meanwhile, Ae Kyo is worried about Jin Dan as he is determined to marry Do Ra, so she meets her in person to end the relationship for him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Do Ra confesses her feelings to Pil Seung and asks him out, but he turns her down on the spot. Even though Pil Seung made himself clear, Do Ra cannot accept his rejection. Meanwhile, Do Jun comes back to Korea and runs into Ma Ri on his way home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Do Ra drags Pil Seung to go to an amusement park, just like back when she was 12 years old. Even though Pil Seung starts to fall for Do Ra as well, he denies his feelings towards her. Meanwhile, Jin Dan apologizes to Do Ra after he gets Angel Investment, and Ae Kyo looks into Soo Yeon's past for Dae Sook.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Sun Young runs into Mi Ja and finds out Geum Ja and Hyun Chul secretly got the money back from Mi Ja and used it for Hyun Chul's business. Meanwhile, Jin Dan causes a scene at the wrap party as he has a misunderstanding about Do Ra and Bong Soo. Furthermore, he takes his anger out on Mi Ja and threatens her to persuade Do Ra.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Mi Ja is infuriated as she witnesses Do Ra with Pil Seung instead of Jin Dan. She barges into Pil Seung's house and causes a scene, so Pil Seung's family also finds out about their relationship. Pil Seung feels awful to see Sun Young in pain, so he decides to end things with Do Ra for good.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Do Ra gets into Mi Ja's car without suspecting anything strange about the photo shoot on Ganghwa Island. But when she arrives, Do Ra is shocked when she sees an unexpected person waiting for her. Meanwhile, Mi Ja's dirty deeds that she kept secret and hidden burst and flood their world, drowning them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Do Ra breaks up with Pil Seung and tells him she is getting engaged to Jin Dan. However, Do Ra calls off the engagement before the ceremony, and Jin Dan is humiliated once again. Mi Ja tries to persuade her before Jin Dan gets back at them, but Jin Dan makes the move right away.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Two years passed after Do Ra's death. Pil Seung becomes a director of his own show, and Jin Dan suffers from nightmares since then. Pil Seung travels out of town with his filming crew for his drama shoot and runs into a lady named Ji Young. Meanwhile, Mi Ja has been released from prison and plans to get back at Jin Dan for ruining her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Ji Young moves to the city to join Pil Seung's team at the broadcasting station but faces trouble finding a proper place to stay. Therefore, Pil Seung offers her and her grandmother a place to move in. Meanwhile, Ji Young reminds Pil Seung of Do Ra in many ways, and Ji Young remembers something about her past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung is confused after he sees Ji Young's tattoo on her ankle, which looks exactly like the one Do Ra had. He travels to her hometown to talk to her grandmother and finds out she had amnesia. Meanwhile, Ma Ri visits Sun Young's place to see Pil Seung again, and Do Jun realizes he used to live with them when he was young.

Entries.Title: Parasyte: The Grey
Entries.Description: After a brutal attack, Jeong Su-in learns she may not be the same person as before. Choi Jun-kyung discovers the monsters are forming an organization.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After a brutal attack, Jeong Su-in learns she may not be the same person as before. Choi Jun-kyung discovers the monsters are forming an organization.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Looking for his sister, Seol Kang-woo investigates Saejin Church, where he finds Su-in. But he soon encounters trouble — and the two fight to escape.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After raiding Saejin Church, Jun-kyung begins suspecting Kim Chul-min is hiding something — later tracking him down meeting with Su-in and Kang-woo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After revealing everything he knows to Chul-min, Kang-woo agrees to help save Su-in. But when the plan goes awry, lives are put at risk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Despite being on the run, Su-in tries to warn Jun-kyung. But as Team Grey's raid plays out, Su-in and Kang-woo realize it's all part of a bigger plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Su-in meets with Seol Kyung-hee, who requests an alliance. But the parasites' ploy for power goes into full effect — and it's up to Heidi to stop them.

Entries.Title: The Auditors
Entries.Description: Shin Cha Il joins JU Construction's Audit Team as the new head. After meeting the team, he has nothing more to say than to ridicule their incompetence and laziness. Cha Il begins reinvestigating a tower crane accident already closed to audit and visits the construction site. When he suspects evidence of corruption on the foreman's laptop, the foreman attempts to run away.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Shin Cha Il joins JU Construction's Audit Team as the new head. After meeting the team, he has nothing more to say than to ridicule their incompetence and laziness. Cha Il begins reinvestigating a tower crane accident already closed to audit and visits the construction site. Entries.Title: Knight Flower
Entries.Description: As a widow, Yeo Hwa cannot leave her home and has to mourn her late husband day and night. However, she often sneaks out at night and helps people in trouble by disguising herself as a man behind a black mask. One day, she hears that Kkot Nim, the little servant she adores, was taken for her father's debts. She goes to the inn where Kkot Nim is and sees Officer Park trying to take her by force.

Episodes.Title: BETWEEN ME AND MY ALTER EGO
Episodes.Description: As a widow, Yeo Hwa cannot leave her home and has to mourn her late husband day and night. However, she often sneaks out at night and helps people in trouble by disguising herself as a man behind a black mask. One day, she hears that Kkot Nim, the little servant she adores, was taken for her father's debts. She goes to the inn where Kkot Nim is and sees Officer Park trying to take her by force.

Episodes.Title: THE FACELESS LADY
Episodes.Description: Yeo Hwa decides to save Kknot Nim by herself. The moment she walks into Pil Inn with her face covered up, she spots Kkot Nim taken away by Soo Ho, the officer of the Capital Defense. Meanwhile, the Minister of Finance summons Soo Ho as a masked man sneaks into his house and steals his precious painting.

Episodes.Title: YOU SEEM SOMEWHAT SIMILAR
Episodes.Description: Soo Ho realizes Kang Pil Jik of Pil Merchant Guild is also searching for the painting that Yeo Hwa stole from the Minister of Finance. Soo Ho leaves a note to the masked hero at Myungdo Inn to give a warning. Meanwhile, Yeo Hwa attends a relief with her mother-in-law and high officials' wives, and a child goes missing out of the blue.

Episodes.Title: EVERYONE HAS A SECRET
Episodes.Description: Soo Ho visits Myungdo Inn to get the painting fixed and runs into the masked hero. She lets him know that Pil Jik has been kidnapping children from shantytown. Soo Ho decides to take care of it as the officer of Capital Defense and tells her to get her hands off the matter. Meanwhile, the King and Yoon Hak look for the members of the late King's guards.

Episodes.Title: A SONG OF JOSEON MEN AND WOMEN
Episodes.Description: Yeo Hwa and Soo Ho find where Pil Jik has been hiding kidnapped children in Pil Inn. They manage to rescue them but are at odds again about where to take the children. Soo Ho wants to take them to the Capital Defense as witnesses to Pil Jik's crime, but Yeo Hwa wants to send them to a safe place first. Meanwhile, the Minister of Finance passes away, and his servant gets arrested as a suspect of murder.

Episodes.Title: WHILE YOU WERE ASLEEP
Episodes.Description: Aware of Yeo Hwa's true identity, Soo Ho takes measures to prevent her from engaging in any reckless behavior. Yoon Hak and Lee So discover that Sung Hoo is the King's Guard who vanished after receiving a secret order from the previous king fifteen years ago. Meanwhile, in her quest for any signs of her brother, Yeo Hwa encounters an unexpected approach from someone.

Episodes.Title: IT IS DARKEST UNDER THE LAMP
Episodes.Description: The King and Yoon Hak find it strange that Ji Sung took in Yeo Hwa, the sister of Cho Sung Hoo, as his daughter-in-law. They believe that he took her as hostage to catch him. At the same time, Ji Sung invites Yoon Hak and Soo Ho to his house. Meanwhile, Nan Kyung wants to talk to Yeo Hwa about her family in private.

Episodes.Title: DESTINY THAT IS SEEMINGLY A COINCIDENCE
Episodes.Description: So Woon looks into Nan Kyung's background and relays the information to Soo Ho. Yeo Hwa also gets a tip from Nan Kyung that her brother's disappearance is related to the matter at the palace. Yeo Hwa asks Ji Sung about her brother, but he tries to hide the truth from her. When Ji Sung secretly leaves the house in the middle of the night, Yeo Hwa follows him.

Episodes.Title: TRUTH OR LIES
Episodes.Description: From Yoon Hak and Su Ho, Yeo Hwa discovers that Ji Sung had her marry into his family to have leverage over her brother, Sung Hoo. Also, Su Ho tells him about his true identity and his parents. They believe Sung Hoo is the one who has the evidence of Ji Sung's treason. Meanwhile, Geum Ok leaves the house to pray for her son in the temple, and Jeong returns home.

Episodes.Title: KEEP YOUR ENEMIES CLOSER
Episodes.Description: Pil Jik fails his mission to take Nan Kyung's life and tries to flee. Ji Sung decides to remove Yeo Hwa before she finds out more about his plot. Also, he threatens the King with the Queen Dowager's safety. Meanwhile, Soo Ho discovers that Ji Sung's son came back alive.

Episodes.Title: A CANDLE IN THE WIND
Episodes.Description: Ji Sung finds out Soo Ho is the son of the former Head of the King's Guard, and Jeong requests Soo Ho to have a chat with him in private. Meanwhile, the King invites Ji Sung and his family to the palace to celebrate Jeong's return, and a surprise guest awaits them.

Episodes.Title: FLOWER THAT BLOOM IN THE NIGHT
Episodes.Description: Yeo Hwa cannot believe the fact that Sung Hoo already died at the hands of her father-in-law, Ji Sung. Pil Jik also confesses that Ji Sung ordered him to murder Sung Hoo and Im Kang's family. However, even though his sin has been revealed to his family, he does not bat an eye and tries to threaten the King. Yeo Hwa loses her mind and decides to kill him right away.

Entries.Title: Captivating the King
Entries.Description: After a Qing-mandated exile, Grand Prince Jinhan returns to a hostile palace. He later encounters an intriguing baduk player who proves to be elusive.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After a Qing-mandated exile, Grand Prince Jinhan returns to a hostile palace. He later encounters an intriguing baduk player who proves to be elusive.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After facing Yi In in a game of baduk, Kang Hee-soo develops feelings for him. Meanwhile, Yi Seon grows increasingly ill, creating a succession crisis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Kim Myung-ha urges Hee-soo to stop her ruse. When a royal crisis arises, Kang Hang-soon performs a selfless act — but Kim Jong-bae schemes against Yi In.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After a confrontation with Yi Seon, Yi In ascends to the throne — but not without opposition. In the process, he cruelly turns a blind eye to Hee-soo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Yi In summons Myung-ha to the palace and appoints him to a special role. To get the attention of the king, Hee-soo takes part in the baduk examination.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Hee-soo receives a stern warning from Yi In upon becoming his official baduk companion, later becoming entangled in a political ploy by the queen dowager.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Yi In begins to suspect a suspicious relationship between Myung-ha and Hee-soo. Later, Hee-soo joins the Grand Prince on a royal trip with the King.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After rumors of Yi In's affection toward Hee-soo spread like wildfire, the palace arranges a royal night of intimacy for him — despite true feelings.

Entries.Title: A Shop for Killers
Entries.Description: Ji-an, who is helplessly attacked in her own home, dodges the flying bullets.

Episodes.Title: Murthehelp
Episodes.Description: Ji-an, who is helplessly attacked in her own home, dodges the flying bullets.

Episodes.Title: Jeong Jin-man, Jeong Jin-man, Jeong Jin-man
Episodes.Description: Jin-man receives an unexpected call; Ji-an, who is alone at home, is pursued by unidentified men.

Episodes.Title: The Strong Don't Howl
Episodes.Description: Ji-an finds herself in danger as she searches for a rescue phone in the mountains to save Jin-man.

Episodes.Title: The Shopping Mall
Episodes.Description: Ji-an and Jeong-min flee from the killers and meet Brother in the underground shopping mall.

Episodes.Title: Babylon
Episodes.Description: Ji-an gets angry as she watches Jin-man on the screen, and Jeong-min points a gun at Ji-an's head.

Episodes.Title: Jeong Jin-man
Episodes.Description: Jin-man, who was once a mercenary of a large company, Babylon, suffers from the truth he learns.

Episodes.Title: Trap
Episodes.Description: Bale, who was presumed to be dead, begins his revenge, and Jin-man fights back to protect Ji-an.

Episodes.Title: Listen Up, Ji-an
Episodes.Description:
Killers close in on Jin-man's house. Ji-an prepares for the final duel on her own.

Season Finale

Entries.Title: Lovely Runner
Entries.Description: Sol had gotten into an accident and had no will to live a life. However, a phone call from Sun-jae, the vocalist of the group Eclipse, gave her hope and comfort. Since that day, she has become Sun-jae's fan. Years have passed, and Sol goes to Sun-jae's concert. But a few hours later, Sun-jae is found dead. And then, Sol goes back to 2008, when Sun-jae was still alive.

Episodes.Title: Live Another Day
Episodes.Description: Sol had gotten into an accident and had no will to live a life. However, a phone call from Sun-jae, the vocalist of the group Eclipse, gave her hope and comfort. Since that day, she has become Sun-jae's fan. Years have passed, and Sol goes to Sun-jae's concert. But a few hours later, Sun-jae is found dead. And then, Sol goes back to 2008, when Sun-jae was still alive.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Protect You
Episodes.Description: Sol is confused about the situation, but one thing she knows is that she must save Sun-jae. She finds out that she can't directly explain the future. To save Sun-jae, she decides to become friends with him, but it's not easy to become friends. Meanwhile, Tae-sung is curious about Sol who changed all of a sudden. And Sun-jae is also bothered by Sol who appeared in front of him from nowhere.

Episodes.Title: It’s All About the Timing
Episodes.Description: Sun-jae wins the gold medal at the competition and he decides to confess his feelings for Sol. But due to unexpected events, it’s not as easy as it seemed. Sol thinks that she has changed the future, but Sun Jae gets hurt during practice. Sun-jae decides to quit swimming and it makes Sol heartbroken. Sol tries to comfort Sun-jae and Sun-jae finally confesses his feelings for her.

Episodes.Title: I’m Back
Episodes.Description: Sol is back in 2023. She couldn't save Sun-jae, but she found out that she did make some changes in the past. She manages to go back in time again, but things have turned out strangely while she was gone. Sol is officially dating Tae-sung and Sun-jae feels confused and betrayed about Sol. He wants to keep a distance from Sol, but Sol keeps showing up. Meanwhile, Sol gets lost on her way home.

Episodes.Title: Sun-jae Sings
Episodes.Description: Sun-jae saves Sol just in time. Sol realizes how precious her life is and tries not to miss out on many things. Tae-sung feels jealous of Sun-jae who seems close to Sol. Meanwhile, the vocalist of Tae-sung's band can't come to the band contest and Sun-jae sings for the band. Sun-jae gives the prize to Sol as a gift, but Sol is upset because he sang in a band which she wanted to prevent from happening.

Episodes.Title: I Liked It That Day
Episodes.Description: Sol breaks up with Tae-sung, thinking he only dated her to avoid the girl who likes him. Sun-jae tries to be cool with Sol so he can win her heart, but it’s not easy for him to hide his feelings. Sol tries to avoid her accident that will happen to her in the future. Meanwhile, Tae-sung gets in an accident and gets hospitalized. At the hospital, he runs into someone unexpected.

Episodes.Title: Thank You for Being Alive
Episodes.Description: Sol manages to escape from the kidnapper and Sun-jae saves him. At that moment, Sol is back in 2023. She is relieved to know that Sun-jae is safe as well, but a lot of things have changed. Her legs are fine and she works at a film production company. Hyun-joo and Geum are married and having another baby. Meanwhile, Sol goes to Sun-jae’s concert to meet him.

Episodes.Title: How About Now?
Episodes.Description: Sol and Sun-jae meet at the Hangang Bridge as they promised. Sol is worried that something might happen to Sun-jae if she lets him go. She insists they spend the night together and the two end up going to Sun-jae's place. They finally realized how they felt about each other after all those years. However, an unexpected accident happens, making Sol flustered again.

Episodes.Title: Sol Goes Back Again
Episodes.Description: Sun-jae is attacked again and he’s in a critical condition. Police disclose information on the culprit and Sol notices that the timeline has changed again. She manages to find a way to get back to the past, and this time, she goes to the same college with Sun-jae. Sol wants to keep distance from Sun-jae, but they keep run into each other. Meanwhile, Sun-jae gets a chance to get a rehabilitation training in the US.

Episodes.Title: I Figured It All Out
Episodes.Description: Sun-jae tells Sol he will leave for the US for the rehabilitation training. Sol is relieved to hear the news as he’ll be safe in the US, but she feels sad at the same time. In-hyuk asks Sun-jae to join his band and go to the audition together. Tae-sung finds out about Sol’s kidnapping case and he comes to see her. Meanwhile, Sun-jae goes to the airport to leave for the US.

Episodes.Title: Become a Couple
Episodes.Description: Sol and Sun-jae decide to be honest with their feelings and enjoy every moment together until Sol goes back to the future. Their parents find out that they are dating, and a small mistake leads to a big misunderstanding. Kim Young-soo is arrested by the police and Sol feels relieved. Meanwhile, In-hyuk's band is performing for the last time and tries to help him.

Episodes.Title: Go On a Trip
Episodes.Description: Kim Young-soo escapes and Sun-jae wants to protect Sol and make her feel relieved. They run into Geum and Hyun-joo and find out about their relationship. In-hyuk goes back to his home in the countryside as he quits the band. Sun-jae, Sol, and Tae-sung go to In-hyuk’s place to tell him that Eclipse might have a chance to debut. Meanwhile, Sol notices that the future has changed.

Episodes.Title: My Future Has Changed
Episodes.Description: Sol lies to Sun-jae and leaves him. Sun-jae comes back to Seoul alone, but he finds out that Sol lied to him. He goes back to find her, but Sol doesn't answer his calls. Meanwhile, Sol asks Detective Kim to help her catch Kim Young-soo. Since she knows when and where the incident will happen, she sets a trap to get him at once. However, the incident brings an unexpected result.

Episodes.Title: The Wrong Script
Episodes.Description: After Sun-jae and Sol's brief and misunderstood encounter at the award ceremony, Sun-jae is accidentally given the wrong script proposed by Sol. However, upon reading it, Sun-jae becomes inexplicably determined to play a role in it while Sol tries her best not to get mixed up with him. But as things don't go the way she wants them to, Sol even thinks about quitting her job.

Episodes.Title: Memories Don't Disappear
Episodes.Description: Sol passes out on the Ferris Wheel and Sun-jae takes her to his place and looks after her. Sol wants to draw a line, but Sun Jae can’t stop having feelings for her. He keeps seeing visions when he’s with Sol, and he wants to know about it. Sun-jae joins Sol’s movie, but on the day of the meeting, he finds out that Sol quit her job. Meanwhile, Tae-sung finds Kim Young-soo.

Episodes.Title: I Remember Everything
Episodes.Description: Sun-jae's memory comes back and now he remembers everything that happened between Sol and him. Thanks to Tae-sung, the ill-fated relations are resolved and the couple can be together. Sun-jae wants to propose to Sol, but finding the right time is difficult. Sun-ae decides to attend Sol’s nephew’s first birthday party and meet Sol’s family.

Entries.Title: Serendipity's Embrace
Entries.Description: Hu-young comes back to Korea and goes on a blind date that Joseph set up for him. There, he runs into Hong-ju. Upon hearing Hu-young’s return to Korea, Hye-ji plans a welcome party for him. However, Hong-ju turns up drunk, sharing all sorts of things Hu-young didn’t expect to hear.

Episodes.Title: My First Love
Episodes.Description: Hu-young comes back to Korea and goes on a blind date that Joseph set up for him. There, he runs into Hong-ju. Upon hearing Hu-young’s return to Korea, Hye-ji plans a welcome party for him. However, Hong-ju turns up drunk, sharing all sorts of things Hu-young didn’t expect to hear.

Episodes.Title: The Ex-Boyfriend
Episodes.Description: Hong-ju turns out to be living downstairs in Hu-young's house, and Hu-young asks his uncle to take him on a tour around Seoul. Hu-young and Hong-ju end up having a date at an amusement park, and they have a fun day together. Meanwhile, Joon-ho, who left Hong-ju three years ago, appeared in front of him, asked to work on a project together.

Episodes.Title: The Confession
Episodes.Description: Hu-young realizes that Hong-ju’s ex is Bang Joon-ho, the writer of “My Avant-Garde Lover.” Hong-ju’s boss tells her to work on a project with Joon-ho. Hong-ju hesitates, but she decides to do it in the end. Hye Ji learns that Hu-young has feelings for Hong-ju. Meanwhile, Hong-ju gets into a car accident.

Episodes.Title: Just Friends
Episodes.Description: Hu-young confesses his feelings to Hong-ju, but she pretends she didn’t hear it. Hong-ju insists on going home instead of staying in the hospital, so Hu-young takes her to his place to take care of her. Joon-ho sees Hu-young and Hong-ju together and gets the wrong idea.

Episodes.Title: What is Love?
Episodes.Description: Hong-ju is forced to go on a fishing trip with Hu-young, Sang-pil, and Wook. Although it’s awkward for her, she tries to enjoy the trip. Hye-ji and Kyung-taek join later, and Hye-ji tells Hong-ju that she’s not dating Kyung-taek. Meanwhile, Hong-ju is told to work with Joon-ho in his studio for a month.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of a New Relationship
Episodes.Description: Hong-ju decides to give Hu-young a shot. Hu-young quits his job to stay in Korea and be with Hong-ju. Hye-ji visits Kyung-taek who fell sick and runs into his mother by coincidence. Meanwhile, Hong-ju’s father calls Jun Ho and tells him to stay away from Hong-ju.

Episodes.Title: Without Saying Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Joon-ho tells Hong-ju why he had to leave her three years ago, but even after hearing the reason, she can’t forgive him for leaving her. Hong-ju meets Hu-young’s mom who tells her to end the relationship. Meanwhile, Hu-young finds out Hong-ju’s new project she’s working on with Joon-ho.

Episodes.Title: Coincidences and Fate
Episodes.Description: Hu-young’s mother tells Hong-ju to come to the US with Hu-young and live there. After hearing that, Hu-young asks Hong-ju to come with him, but she turns him down. Hu-young doesn’t get to see Hong-ju on the day he leaves for the US, but a surprise awaits him at the airport.

Entries.Title: Under The Gun
Entries.Description: Ko Gun's school life lacks any significant interests as his busy part-time schedules consume his time after classes. However, everything changes when Se Young, a transfer student from LA, joins his class and ends up sitting next to him. Initially indifferent, their frequent encounters gradually ignite a spark in Gun's life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ko Gun's school life lacks any significant interests as his busy part-time schedules consume his time after classes. However, everything changes when Se Young, a transfer student from LA, joins his class and ends up sitting next to him. Initially indifferent, their frequent encounters gradually ignite a spark in Gun's life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Se Young firmly believes that fate dictates the frequent crossings of her path with Gun's, and she wastes no time in showing her affection for him. On the other hand, Gun, carrying the weight of his obligations, has little patience for frivolous romance. Despite this, Se Young's presence manages to stir some interest in him. Meanwhile, Gun's encounter with Tae Ha appears to be far from amicable.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Ko Gun returns to the illegal gambling spot to make a few more bucks. However, he gets caught up in a bad hand and returns home with cuts and bruises. Meanwhile, as Se Young helps a drunk man home, she runs into Ko Gun at the drunk man's door.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Se Young can't get enough of Gun, and she follows him everywhere, even to his part-time job at the convenience store. Gun takes her to Ji Chul's bar, and she learns about the upcoming Hold'em tournament. Meanwhile, Gun's sister's health deteriorates, forcing Gun to find a means to save her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Gun stands before the court for illegal gambling. With the help of petitions from his schoolmates, the court sentences him to 100 hours of community service, and he promises not to get involved in illegal gambling activities. Meanwhile, Gun continues to push Se Young away when he returns to school.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Gun is fueled by a heartfelt determination to clinch victory in the 2022 KPL championship, yet his performance in the final game appears unpromising. Despite feeling trapped with unfavorable circumstances stacked against him, he remains resolute, driven by his deep love and dedication to Jun Hee, his father, and Se Young. Although the odds seem insurmountable, he refuses to concede defeat until the very end.

Entries.Title: Doubt
Entries.Description: Tae-su's tenacity makes him South Korea's top profiler. But his work gets in the way of being a parent, especially when his daughter is a suspect.

Episodes.Title: I know that I haven't been a good dad until now.
Episodes.Description: Tae-su's tenacity makes him South Korea's top profiler. But his work gets in the way of being a parent, especially when his daughter is a suspect.

Episodes.Title: Is it really an accident regarding Ha-jun?
Episodes.Description: Tae-su wants to trust his daughter, but all evidence points to Ha-bin. He draws suspicion from Officer Dae-hong, who begins investigating the case.

Episodes.Title: You become better at lying.
Episodes.Description: New revelations emerge as Tae-su investigates Ha-bin's alibi, while Eo-jin begins to question Tae-su's involvement in the case.

Episodes.Title: How can you be so sure?
Episodes.Description: After Tae-su submits a keychain as evidence, the police discover a link to another case. Yeong-min is brought in for questioning once more.

Episodes.Title: Our Habin
Episodes.Description: Tae-su receives a shocking call as secrets begin to tumble out. Agitation and suspicion over the unfolding investigation begin to mount.

Episodes.Title: I'll Tell You Everything...Let's Meet
Episodes.Description: While Dae-hong is disappointed with the changes in Tae-su, Eo-jin learns about her colleague’s past. Ha-bin reaches a breaking point with Yeong-min.

Episodes.Title: What Habin Saw
Episodes.Description: Another murder forces Tae-su to question his daughter as the evidence points to her involvement. Jun-tae turns himself in.

Episodes.Title: When Did You Start Suspecting Her?
Episodes.Description: A mysterious envelope arrives at the police station. Ducheol blackmails Taesoo using Habin. Habin learns the secret behind Jisu's death, while Eojin firmly suspects Habin as the killer.

Episodes.Title: Prove You're Not the Killer
Episodes.Description: The violent crimes unit identifies Habin as a suspect. Taesoo realizes there's no escape this time. He desperately tries to block the investigation, but soon faces a shocking truth through the evidence seized from Habin.

Episodes.Title: I Believe You
Episodes.Description: The true killer is revealed, but the motive behind the murder remains unclear. Habin refuses to let go of the intent to kill, leaving Taesoo with deep guilt. Can this father-daughter duo live a normal life from now on?

Episodes.Title: Episode 8

Episodes.Title: Episode 9

Episodes.Title: Episode 11

Episodes.Title: Episode 12

Episodes.Title: Episode 13

Episodes.Title: Episode 14

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Shocked by unexpected news, Isoo is tormented. Meanwhile, Ganghyun investigates to help Isoo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16

Entries.Description: At Seongsan Village where the spirit of Joseon lives on, scholar Yun-bok tracks a thief. In Seoul, designer Hong-do toils at the bottom of the ladder.

Episodes.Description: At Seongsan Village where the spirit of Joseon lives on, scholar Yun-bok tracks a thief. In Seoul, designer Hong-do toils at the bottom of the ladder.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Yun-bok infiltrates the club with help from a friend, but Hong-do still avoids him. Hong-do’s design gets stolen, yet no one is listening to her woes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hong-do raises hell at work but gets a lucky break! Yun-bok is sick, and Hong-do feels responsible. Top designer Camille chooses her next runway.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Yun-bok and Hong-do grow closer over the weekend. While probing a 17-year-old case, Yun-bok hatches a plan. Camille sends Hong-do to Seongsan Village.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: A strange woman visits Yun-bok. Hong-do wants clarification, but she gets heartache instead. Camille decides to revisit an old flame after 46 years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Hong-do is surprised by her feelings for Yun-bok. Su-geun and Camille lock horns on the fashion show, but a crisis at Seongsan Village prompts action.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Past hurts make Yun-bok shut out Hong-do. As an apology, he grants her wishes. Camille moves into Seongsan with hopes of moving the villagers’ hearts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Hong-do feels for Yun-bok, but he's walled off his heart. Wedding preparations have begun — with or without the groom. And more pain comes to light.

Entries.Title: The Brave Yong Su Jeong
Entries.Description: Su Jeong's parents, Yo Sub and Je In, set off to get treatment for Je In's cancer and leaves Su Jeong with Han Yang. Han Yang's daughter, Na Ra, gets extremely jealous of Su Jeong as she has everything she wants. After a couple of days, Han Yang watches shocking news about Yo Sub and Je In on television.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Su Jeong's parents, Yo Sub and Je In, set off to get treatment for Je In's cancer and leaves Su Jeong with Han Yang. Han Yang's daughter, Na Ra, gets extremely jealous of Su Jeong as she has everything she wants. After a couple of days, Han Yang watches shocking news about Yo Sub and Je In on television.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Amidst the chaos of an unexpected fire, Han Yang swiftly gathers her belongings and departs with Na Ra, leaving Su Jeong stranded as she struggles to save her mother. Witnessing the flames engulfing Su Jeong's home, Jang Won senses something extraordinary and rushes inside.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Kyung Hwa directs Myung Chul to create a new will excluding Young Ae. Later, at a temple, she fervently prays for punishment against Joo Sung Pil, hoping Young Ae suffers if alive. Coincidentally, Young Ae instinctively hides upon seeing Kyung Hwa. Meanwhile, due to Eui Ju's actions, Su Jeong is caught in a hostage situation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description:
Together with his son who was born soon, the two hats were left to Monk Cheonjin (played by Kim Chu-wol). Afterwards, the boy grew up to be a Yeo-ju (played by Seo Joon-young) and appeared in a reliable military uniform.

Yong-jong stopped by the store to change the helmet that fell off. He tried on a new helmet, but it didn't come off.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description:
After being sick in the temple due to an unexpected disturbance, Yongsu met Joo Woo-jin, who came to serve his father's Samwoo ritual, and expressed his joy. Yongsu was in a crush on Joo Woo-jin, who saved him when he was about to fall in the lobby of the company last time. However, contrary to expectations, Joo Woo-jin could not even remember Yong Soo-jung and even heard the words gossiping about Joo, and there was only an awkward atmosphere between the two.

Joo Woo-jin (Kwon Hwa-woon) collapsed in an elevator that suddenly stopped. When Yong Soo-jung, who was surprised, called and tried to ask for help, Joo Woo-jin stopped it. Yong Soo-jung used a plastic bag to help Joo Woo-jin breathe comfortably.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description:
On this day, Min Kyung-hwa (Lee Seung-yeon) told Joo Woo-jin, "Keep the people responsible, especially the show host," as Yong Soo-jung's collapse during a home shopping broadcast led to a drop in stock prices.

Angered by the fact that a disciplinary committee is being held under Joo Woo-jin's direction, Yong-jung leaves the office to meet him and Choi Hye-ra, who was watching, smiles with remorse.

Entries.Title: Hierarchy
Entries.Description: Kang Ha enters Jooshin High and quickly ruffles some feathers. He soon attends a rowdy party — and partakes in a provocative game of truth or dare.

Episodes.Title: Newbie Party: Truth or Dare
Episodes.Description: Kang Ha enters Jooshin High and quickly ruffles some feathers. He soon attends a rowdy party — and partakes in a provocative game of truth or dare.

Episodes.Title: Secret: Within a Secret
Episodes.Description: After Kang Ha's daring stunt at the party, he faces the vengeful Kim Ri-an at school. Later, at a retreat, Kang Ha and Jung Jae-i begin to get closer.

Episodes.Title: Hierarchy: A League of Their Own
Episodes.Description: As Jae-i and Kang Ha present as a couple, a jealous Ri-an resorts to his own tactics. At the lavish Parent's Night, Yoon He-ra pulls a hostile stunt.

Episodes.Title: Revenge, Desire, Romance: The Heart of the Matter
Episodes.Description: He-ra plants a suspicion about Jae-i in Kang Ha's head. As anonymous threats continue to plague Jae-i, she disappears from school.

Episodes.Title: Outstanding Outsiders: The Kangs
Episodes.Description: After Kang Ha's confession, Jae-i is overwhelmed by the truth and decides to leave. At her farewell party, Ri-an makes an entrance — and a declaration.

Episodes.Title: An Arrow: To the Heart
Episodes.Description: Kang Ha plans a strike to make the school an even playing field. But Jae-i attempts to protect Ri-an from the blow, revealing a hidden secret to Kang Ha.

Episodes.Title: Spring Time: Our Short, Vulnerable Yet Precious Chapter
Episodes.Description: Kang Ha's crusade against the bullies wreaks havoc at the school. As a reckoning unfolds at Jooshin, will Kang Ha finally be able to fulfill his purpose?

Entries.Title: Pyramid Game
Entries.Description: Soo Ji transfers to Baekyeon Girls’ High School and discovers that her class plays a game called the Pyramid Game in which the students decide on a hierarchy based on a popular vote. As Soo Ji ends up in the lowest rank, she devises a plan to get back on her feet.

Episodes.Title: Sung Soo Ji: The Transfer Student
Episodes.Description: Soo Ji transfers to Baekyeon Girls’ High School and discovers that her class plays a game called the Pyramid Game in which the students decide on a hierarchy based on a popular vote. As Soo Ji ends up in the lowest rank, she devises a plan to get back on her feet.

Episodes.Title: The Mastermind of the Pyramid Game
Episodes.Description: Soo Ji is determined to figure out the characteristics of her classmates and the mastermind behind the Pyramid Game. She also tries to join forces with other girls who seem vulnerable. She even asks her homeroom teacher for help, only to be disappointed. Meanwhile, the 14th Pyramid Game begins, and Ja Eun, who kept skipping school, shows up.

Episodes.Title: The Birth of a Trio
Episodes.Description: Soo Ji moves up to Grade C, and the treatment she gets changed completely overnight. She breaks the promise she made with Ja Eun, but she decides to join hands with her and help the new girl in Grade F, Pyo Ji Ae. Soo Ji, Ja Eun, and Ji Ae come up with a plan to destroy the pyramid altogether.

Episodes.Title: The Leaked Plan
Episodes.Description: Soo Ji begins to feel uneasy about the unfolding events, suspecting that her plan may have been compromised and that Ha Rin is catching on. Learning this, Pyo Ji Ae worries she may have made a mistake and dreads the potential consequences. Meanwhile, Soo Ji hints to Hae Jun that she holds leverage over her, coercing Hae Jun into assisting her. Soo Ji recruits a hacker to join her team.

Episodes.Title: Parent Observation Day
Episodes.Description: During the parents' visit to the school, Soo Ji gets caught up in Ha Rin's trap. While Soo Ji tries to make a pact with Do Ah,  Seung Yi puts on a show to put Soo Ji on the spot. Although the parents witness the ordeal, Ha Rin turns the situation to her advantage and even has her grandmother, the chairwoman of Baekyeon Group. Meanwhile, Soo Ji switches to her Plan B.

Episodes.Title: Tables Turned
Episodes.Description: With no Grade F in the 15th game, Soo Ji changes gears to eliminate the game with Ye Lim's help. First, she suggests voting to revoke Grade A privileges and puts Ha Rin on the spot. Meanwhile, Ha Rin doesn't give in to Soo Ji's hindrances and thinks of a plan to demolish Soo Ji's game.

Episodes.Title: Shattering Friendship
Episodes.Description: Baekyeon Girls’ High School goes on a school retreat. While practicing diving, someone pushes Ha Rin into the water, and Ja Yeon jumps in to save her. The next day, Class Five plays a survival game using paint guns. The last five standing, Soo Ji, Ja Eun, Jae Hyung, Eun Jung, and Ji Ae are put in danger of ending up in Grade F.

Episodes.Title: The Majority
Episodes.Description: Soo Ji decides to recruit more girls to end the game and Ha Rin for good. When Da Yeon is about to be punished for what she did to Eun Jung, their teacher tells everyone that Da Yeon has to transfer to another school. Meanwhile, right before the Pyramid Game is held, Ye Lim gets taken to the hospital.

Episodes.Title: The Final Vote
Episodes.Description: The 16th Pyramid Game begins, and Ha Rin suggests choosing a classmate who will become a permanent Grade F. Before the voting takes place, Soo Ji tells the class that Ye Lim was attacked and hospitalized. The class decides to vote on whether to stay. playing or not, and the entire process is broadcast live, causing the school to be in an uproar. Meanwhile, Ja Eun tells Soo Ji what she did to Ha Rin when they were little.

Episodes.Title: The Verdict
Episodes.Description: Ja Eun reveals what she used to do to Ha Rin, but Soo Ji thinks Ha Rin is just using it as an excuse to make Ja Eun's life miserable. The school and Baekyeon Group decide to blame Soo Ji and her group for the violence at school, but Ms. Yoon Na Hee takes action and reveals the video of Soo Ji being bullied. Meanwhile, Soo Ji reveals the corruption behind the teacher recruitment.

Entries.Title: When the Phone Rings
Entries.Description: After receiving a call from Hong Hee-joo's kidnapper, Paik Sa-eon attempts to learn more about him — only to find it's hard to escape his surveillance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After receiving a call from Hong Hee-joo's kidnapper, Paik Sa-eon attempts to learn more about him — only to find it's hard to escape his surveillance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Sa-eon works quickly to track down the caller, forcing Hee-joo to stay hypervigilant. Despite her fears, she continues to play along with the ruse.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After Sa-eon experiences an attack, he grows wary of Hee-joo's relationship with her friend. Meanwhile, an ominous figure makes his presence known.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After receiving the ominous call, Hee-joo abandons her clandestine plan. She then undergoes a tough interview with Sa-eon — sharing an intimate moment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Sa-eon grapples with feelings of betrayal after learning the truth about Hee-joo. However, when she receives good news, they begin to grow fonder.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Hee-joo confronts a figure from her past who wishes to reveal what she knows. She then embarks on a retreat with Sa-eon — who becomes possessive of her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Sa-eon and Hee-joo's relationship shifts after her harrowing rescue. Determined to catch the kidnapper, Sa-eon goes full force — with the help of 406.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: As Hee-joo and Sa-eon grow closer, the threat from the kidnapper intensifies. Sa-eon discovers an ominous and shocking clue from a past figure.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Hee-joo worries about Sa-eon after learning the truth about him. She later appears on the stage of her dreams, side by side with her love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: While attempting to rescue Hee-joo, Sa-eon discovers another surprising conspirator — whom he later tries to persuade to help locate the kidnapper.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: After Hee-joo's bold move, her fate and that of her kidnapper remain uncertain. But Sa-eon refuses to give up — leaving no stone unturned to find her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Sa-eon abandons everything he's worked for, leaving Hee-joo completely alone. But after a clue arrives, she embarks on a journey to reunite with him.

Episodes.Description: Violinist Seo Dong-ha, set to study in Vienna, faces hatred and contempt as Kim Guk-ho's son.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Smile

Episodes.Title: Slaughter
Episodes.Description: Yoon Chang-jae, who lost an ear to a roulette game, plans something dangerous to obtain the bounty.

Episodes.Title: The Unholy Maestro
Episodes.Description: Pastor Seong Jun-u of Midian Church is respected and admired, but he harbors a secretive past.

Entries.Title: The Frog

Episodes.Title: Do You Know What They Call People Like Us?
Episodes.Description: Jeon Yeong-ha leisurely runs a peaceful vacation rental after his wife's death — until one day, unexpected guests find a way to his accommodation.

Episodes.Title: Who Will Come Knocking on the Door of My Destiny?
Episodes.Description: Yeong-ha begins to feel uneasy about his former guest. Koo Sang-jun faces his guilt after the grisly consequences of leaving his motel unattended.

Episodes.Title: As Though You Couldn't Get Me Off Your Mind
Episodes.Description: The mysterious woman returns unannounced, forcing Yeong-ha to confront her. As Sang-jun's family life spirals, he contemplates speaking out publicly.

Episodes.Title: I Think She Killed a Child
Episodes.Description: After helping Sang-jun with his case, Yoon Bo-min naturally gravitates towards violent crimes. Yeong-ha becomes troubled by the woman's erratic behavior.

Episodes.Title: I'm Just "It" in This Game of Tag
Episodes.Description: What began as a truth-seeking journey turns into a turf war for Yeong-ha and the woman — growing more intense each round, with no end in sight.

Episodes.Title: Dad Will Come Get You
Episodes.Description: Yeong-ha researches the crumbling motel to figure out his next move, encountering Koo Gi-ho, who can't seem to let go of the past.

Episodes.Title: We'll See the End Together
Episodes.Description: After a confrontation at her art exhibit, Yoo Seong-a's actions become increasingly brutal — even involving Yeong-ha's daughter in her game.

Episodes.Title: We'll Have a Lot to Talk About
Episodes.Description: When Bo-min gets a hunch about Seong-a's misdeeds, she sets out to find evidence. But Yeong-ha resolves to stop her himself before it's too late.

Entries.Description: A crime unit with the lowest arrest rate gets started on its first case with its new chief, Yubin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A crime unit with the lowest arrest rate gets started on its first case with its new chief, Yubin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The team investigates a murder disguised as a suicide and gets in a bind as another death occurs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: The team advances the investigation with information from the witness. Yubin identifies the suspect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: A fire breaks out at a fried chicken shop run by Joongryeok's acquaintance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The team narrows down the arson suspects but hits a dead end. Yubin then proposes a shocking theory.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Following Yubin's lead, the team pivots their investigation and uncovers new information.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: A six-year-old girl is kidnapped. Amid the kidnapper's threats, Yubin dismisses a prime suspect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Another team takes over the case, but Yubin's team secretly continues probing, sparking a showdown.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Armed with Tansik's clue, the team sneaks into a restricted area and faces a perilous situation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10

Episodes.Title: Episode 11

Episodes.Title: Episode 12

Episodes.Title: Episode 13

Episodes.Title: Episode 14

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Yubin's team uncovers a union of gangsters and forms the Dongbang Group to infiltrate it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Yubin's team leads a double life and manages to meet the right-hand man of the MZ Union's boss.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: A university student is found to have been murdered the same way Yubin's fiancée was.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Hyunwoo identifies the murderer. Meanwhile, Junghwan obtains CCTV evidence but falls in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Joongryeok hunts down Junghwan's attacker, while Yubin discovers crucial evidence has vanished.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: The team trusts Yubin's claim that the real murderer is still out there, and gathers evidence.

Entries.Title: Family by Choice
Entries.Description: A family of three moves into the Oryun Mansion Complex, and Ju-won meets San-ha, the brother she always wanted, for the first time. Despite Ju-won's eager wish to get to know him, San-ha has trouble accepting her due to his family's situation. Meanwhile, San-ha's father meets Kang Seo-hyun, a single mother with a son named Hae-joon.

Episodes.Title: Ju-won, San-ha, and Hae-joon Meet
Episodes.Description: A family of three moves into the Oryun Mansion Complex, and Ju-won meets San-ha, the brother she always wanted, for the first time. Despite Ju-won's eager wish to get to know him, San-ha has trouble accepting her due to his family's situation. Meanwhile, San-ha's father meets Kang Seo-hyun, a single mother with a son named Hae-joon.

Episodes.Title: One Family Name
Episodes.Description: After growing up together as a family, Ju-won, San-ha, and Hae-joon go to high school together. San-ha and Hae-joon are hot with the girls, causing Ju-won to deal with the onslaught of requests from the girls to deliver their love message to them. Meanwhile, Ju-won longs to live under one family name through adoption, which the others think is absurd. Later, Hae-joon catches a suspicious man taking photos of him.

Episodes.Title: Two Fathers
Episodes.Description: A man visits Hae-joon at school and reveals that he is Hae-joon's birth father. Although Hae-joon is initially speechless, he feels relieved to learn that his father has not abandoned him. To find out more about his father, he and San-ha talk with Aunt Yi-hyun to gain insight into his father's character before meeting him in person and uncovering the reasons for his sudden return after all these years.

Episodes.Title: An Unwelcome Visitor
Episodes.Description: Ju-won feels exhilarated about going on a date with a boy who is good-looking and smart, but she soon gets disappointed by what he says to her. San-ha and his father are upset by an unwelcome visitor who reminds San-ha of memories he doesn’t want to recall. A surprise present from Hae-joon’s biological father brings about a conflict between Hae-joon and his colleague.

Episodes.Title: Hae-joon’s Birthday
Episodes.Description: With Hae-joon’s birthday around the corner, San-ha and Hae-joon get into a big fight. To help them reconcile, Ju-won plans to take them to a rail bike. However, many misunderstandings develop as Ju-won collapses from a cold, and rumours between Dal and Hae-joon spread at the school. Meanwhile, everyone gets ready as Yi-hyun plans to join the birthday party.

Episodes.Title: Visit from Hae-joon’s Mom
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon’s mother, Seo-hyun, unexpectedly visits Yoon’s Kalguksu to repay her debt, leaving Jung Jae puzzled as to what to do with it. Meanwhile, So-hee goes missing after leaving home to meet San-ha. Her disappearance reignites the unresolved conflict between Moo-sung and Jeong-hee, resulting in San-ha's decision to distance himself from the family.

Episodes.Title: The Basketball Game
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon finds out that his mother had come to pay back her debt, but did not stay long enough to see him. After CSAT, misunderstandings between San-ha, Ju-won, Hae-joon, and Dal build up as they are clueless about each other’s true feelings. Meanwhile, Hae-joon’s birth father watches his son’s basketball game and suggests he study further in the US.

Episodes.Title: Leaving the Countryside
Episodes.Description: San-ha stays in Seoul to look after his step-sister while his mother recovers from surgery. Ju-won goes to Seoul alone to surprise him without telling the rest of the family. Meanwhile back at home, Jeong-jae collapses from overworking, scaring everyone, especially Hae-joon, who makes up his mind about going to the US.

Episodes.Title: A Decade Later
Episodes.Description: Ju-won is shocked to find out both San-ha and Hae-joon have made up their mind to leave for Seoul and the US. Feeling a part of the family will be missing, she can’t help but cry. Jeong -jae also feels bad sending the boys away and feels empty in heart. Ten years passed, San-ha and Hae-joon came back as two grown-ups.

Episodes.Title: Awkward Reunion
Episodes.Description: San-ha and Hae-joon come back on Ju-won’s birthday after ten years. Though they haven’t seen each other for years, unlike what Ju-won had imagined, she feels indifferent about their return and is not happy to see them. Meanwhile, the family finds out a shocking truth about Hae-joon at Ju-won’s birthday celebration.

Episodes.Title: San-ha’s Confession
Episodes.Description: San-ha’s sudden confession startles Ju-won. While she tries to deny any romance between them and stay as siblings, she is overcome with mixed feelings. Hae-joon jokingly suggests getting married to Ju-won, upsetting San-ha. Meanwhile, a surprise visit from Seo-hyun shocks Jeong-jae as an unexpected turn of events takes place.

Episodes.Title: A New Start
Episodes.Description: San-ha and Ju-won finally confirm their feelings for one another. However, they soon become worried about how to break the news to their family and friends. Meanwhile, Hae-joon tries to pay back Jeong-jae for everything he has done for him, but some misunderstandings develop as Hae-joon’s source of money is revealed.

Episodes.Title: San-ha Having Insomnia
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon finds out that San-ha is struggling with insomnia and taking medication. So-hui comes to visit San-ha alone without telling Jeong-hee and asks him to stay with her and Jeong-hee. Dal keeps trying to hide her feelings for Hae-joon. Meanwhile, a big secret between Ju-won and San-ha is about to be revealed by none other than Hae-joon.

Episodes.Title: Unchosen, Unloved, Alone
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon is filled with a deep sense of betrayal as he watches San-ha and Ju-won on the verge of kissing, struggling to understand how Ju-won could accept San-ha as a boyfriend. He’s haunted by the fear that, like everyone else before them, they too will eventually leave him. Meanwhile, though he knows where his mother is, Hae-joon watches her from a distance, and each glimpse only fuels his growing hatred for her.

Episodes.Title: San-ha Getting Hurt
Episodes.Description: Everyone is happy with San-ha and Ju-won dating, except one person. San Ha gets hurt and rushed to the emergency room and even Jeong-jae and Dae-uk hurriedly come to check on him. Hae-joon decides to play basketball again. Dal is deeply disappointed and devastated. Meanwhile, when Ju-won is alone at her bakery, an unwelcome visitor comes to see her.

Episodes.Title: Someone for Everyone
Episodes.Description: San-ha can't wait any longer. He approaches Jeong-jae and requests his approval to be with Ju-won. Ju-won and Hae-joon try to work some romantic magic between Jeong-jae and Seo-hyun while Dal goes on a blind date, as suggested by Jae-eun. However, Hae-joon doesn't like the idea and doesn't let his chance go. Meanwhile, Jeong-hee plans to move to the UK with So-hee.

Entries.Description: Dr. Jung-woo is a skilled plastic surgeon known for his 'golden hands' and high reputation. One night, he must perform emergency surgery on a crime victim instead of a cosmetic procedure, earning him recognition as a heroic doctor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Dr. Jung-woo is a skilled plastic surgeon known for his 'golden hands' and high reputation. One night, he must perform emergency surgery on a crime victim instead of a cosmetic procedure, earning him recognition as a heroic doctor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Detective Min-hyung finds a surprising name in a suicide note, putting Jung-woo in trouble. After the hospital director announces support, Jung-woo must perform surgery for crime victims. He and Min-hyung clash as they work together again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: While investigating Jung-woo's relationship with the suicide note, Min-hyung discovers that he is connected to a horrific incident from seven years ago.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jung-woo is about to jump off the roof when a patient makes him stop dead in his tracks. Min-hyung tracks a suspicious man around Jung-woo and is shocked when he finally confronts him and discovers his true identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Min-hyung finds the home invasion culprit, but Jung-woo offers a medical opinion that contradicts the investigation. Meanwhile, a patient treated by Woo-jin recognizes the injured victim and shares suspicious rumors.

Entries.Title: The Whirlwind
Entries.Description: Determined to turn the tables, Park Dong-ho attempts to assassinate the president. But Jeong Su-jin swiftly steps in to execute her own agenda.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Determined to turn the tables, Park Dong-ho attempts to assassinate the president. But Jeong Su-jin swiftly steps in to execute her own agenda.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Armed with leverage, Kang Sang-un approaches Dong-ho with an offer. Dong-ho's attempt to initiate a no-holds-barred investigation encounters a hiccup.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Dong-ho risks everything to reinitiate the investigation before the president awakes. In response, Su-jin resorts to a ruthless tactic to turn the tides.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Dong-ho turns his attention to the presidential election campaign — and sets a trap for Su-jin. He later enlists questionable support for a leg up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Facing calls to resign, Dong-ho confronts Su-jin privately. He soon debates Jo Sang-cheon, where the issue of North Korea plagues Dong-ho's campaign.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Although Su-jin gains possession of Dong-ho's Achilles' heel, Dong-ho reveals he has a trick up his sleeve. Su-jin then hones in on Park Chang-sik.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Dong-ho enacts a scheme to completely expose Su-jin to the public. But she aims to turn Lee Jang-seok against Dong-ho before her hearing begins.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: With Su-jin in the prime minister's seat, Dong-ho meets with Chairman Kang in a ploy to take her inner circle down — forcing her to plan her own revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Su-jin coaches Sang-un to give a damning testimony against Dong-ho and sway public opinion. Facing impeachment, Dong-ho turns to Chairman Kang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Dong-ho exposes himself to bring his foes to justice, putting himself at risk for prosecution. In turn, Su-jin stops at nothing to have Dong-ho arrested.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Su-jin derails the investigation into Daejin and turns the scrutiny back onto Dong-ho. As a strike threatens Dong-ho's power, he uses his silver bullet.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Dong-ho's final act forces Su-jin to make the ultimate choice — reveal the truth or go down in disgrace. In the end, will justice prevail?

Entries.Title: The Atypical Family
Entries.Description: After a couple of healing massages, Bok Man-huem invites Do Da-hae to a dinner, where a fight ensues. Da-hae later recounts her findings to the gang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After a couple of healing massages, Bok Man-huem invites Do Da-hae to a dinner, where a fight ensues. Da-hae later recounts her findings to the gang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Da-hae helps Bok Gwi-ju shop for a gift, who in turn shows up during her time of need. Soon, during an involuntary date, they receive a call for help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Gwi-ju begins to revisit past memories, which share a surprising similarity. Da-hae moves into the Bok residence, finding friction among its members.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Da-hae experiences larger-than-life occurences at the Bok residence. Gwi-ju catches Da-hae red-handed, but later begins to open up about his secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Da-hae attempts to fool Gwi-ju into a union, despite his skepticism. She later visits Bok I-na at her school which triggers a trauma from her past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Gwi-ju tries to win Da-hae over after recent ordeals force her to pull away. But as Da-hae gets close to her goal, Bok Dong-hee finds damning evidence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Even after the disastrous recent event, Gwi-ju keeps revisiting his past with Da-hae. Meanwhile, Baek Il-hong sees another opportunity to strike.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Despite Da-hae's objections, Gwi-ju pushes for more quality time with her. Soon, Il-hong's gang finds themselves becoming more entangled with the Boks.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Il-hong's plan to fracture the Bok family begins to take effect, forcing Da-hae to confront her. Da-hae and Gwi-ju later search for the missing I-na.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Man-huem's frightening premonition forces her to give somber news to the family. During a road trip, Gwi-ju and Da-hae experience a momentous incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: While Gwi-ju's fate becomes known to everyone, his family and Da-hae resolve to keep him safe. Da-hae and Grace Kang help Dong-hee find her worth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: As Gwi-ju awaits the inevitable, catastrophe strikes I-na's dance competition. Can Gwi-ju fulfill his ultimate purpose before it's too late?

Entries.Title: Black Out
Entries.Description: Two girls go missing in a peaceful village a day after the SAT exam. While the evidence of murder is discovered but not the corpses, Jung-Woo, a model student and the classmate of the two missing girls, is suspected. She confesses but claims the blackout for not remembering anything. 10 years later, she serves out her sentence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Two girls go missing in a peaceful village a day after the SAT exam. While the evidence of murder is discovered but not the corpses, Jung-Woo, a model student and the classmate of the two missing girls, is suspected. She confesses but claims the blackout for not remembering anything. 10 years later, she serves out her sentence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jung-Woo arrives at a warehouse where the incident happened and falls in great agony over the memory of that day. Hearing about her mom's accident belatedly, Jung-Woo tries to determine the cause while everyone in the village distrusts her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: As Jung-Woo traces her mom's accident, detective Sang-Cheol suspects her when he finds out who Jung-Woo is. Ha-Seol, who got interested in the village's past incident, pays attention to the strange bone she found.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: While the investigation of Boyoung's father, the key suspect in the fall of Jung-Woo's mom, is continued, Jung-Woo finally finds Boyoung and gets shocked.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Nakyum feels bad for Jung-Woo's circumstances and urges her to leave for Seoul together. An investigation of the past incident of Jung-Woo begins, and Sang-Cheol casts doubt on the case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Boyoung's mom's demand provokes Goo-Tak. Also, Ha-Seol notices something strange from the village neighbors when Su-Oh falls into a fit. Meanwhile, Ha-Seol is astonished to see Su-Oh back from the hospital, who seems completely different.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The one who threatened Jung-Woo with a gun was Boyoung's father, who got released. Gun-Oh suddenly comes back from the States, and the way Goo-Tak looks at Gun-Oh is suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Jung-Woo gets shattered by the thing inside Gun-Oh's bag he brought. Su-Oh, trapped in the mental hospital, tries to tell Ha-Seol the secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Sang-Cheol strikes against Byeong-Moo, who tries to block Gun-Oh's investigation. Simultaneously, Minsu discloses the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Goo-Tak gets devasted by Gun-Oh's suicide. Na-Kyum reveals to Boyoung's parents that Byeong-Mu and Minsu are involved in Boyoung's death, and the entire village becomes enraged.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: New evidence begins to resurface from the car that Jeong-woo's father had hidden. The anger of Bo-yeong's father, who has uncovered the truth, reaches a boiling point.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Shocking truths continue to be revealed after the shooting carried out by Bo-yeong's father. Hyeong-sik falls into a panic, while Sang-cheol puts pressure on Gu-tak.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Jeong-woo is deeply affected by the death of Min-su's father. At the same time, Bo-yeong's funeral is held, and Sang-cheol continues his investigation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Na-gyeom reveals the shocking truth of that night. A dangerous situation arises for Jeong-woo, who finally learns the whole truth. The gubernatorial election reaches its climax and the last remaining door to the truth opens.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
