Entries.Title: Branding in Seongsu
Entries.Description: Despite Na-eon's continued success in securing significant marketing deals, she finds herself bothered by an intern named Eun-ho. Despite being just an intern, Eun-ho consistently disrupts Na-eon's routine. Frustrated, Na-eon decides to confront Eun-ho in an eerie location, possibly indicating that she has reached her limit.

Episodes.Title: You Are Not My Junior
Episodes.Description: Despite Na-eon's continued success in securing significant marketing deals, she finds herself bothered by an intern named Eun-ho. Despite being just an intern, Eun-ho consistently disrupts Na-eon's routine. Frustrated, Na-eon decides to confront Eun-ho in an eerie location, possibly indicating that she has reached her limit.

Episodes.Title: Cruelty Free XU Beauty
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho vehemently opposes animal cruelty, and it was this very conviction that led him to take a stand against his own company when he was just an intern during a recent incident. To quell his curiosity, Na-eon puts an end to his suspicions by arranging a meeting with XU Beauty. Content for the moment, Eun-ho quickly moves on to visit one of XU Beauty's factories, unaware of the surprises that await him later in the day.

Episodes.Title: XU Cruelty
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho, oblivious to the gravity of the information he stumbled upon, feels compelled to share his discovery with Na-eon. However, her reaction is unexpectedly calm, contrasting with his anticipation. Despite the unsettling nature of what he witnessed at the factory, the collaboration between XU Beauty and Seongsu Agency proceeds seamlessly, leaving Eun-ho bewildered by the apparent ease with which the project advances.

Episodes.Title: The Downfall
Episodes.Description: The Na-eon's XU Beauty event unfolds seamlessly, garnering a positive response from the public. Yet, what appeared to be another flawless project marks the onset of Na-eon's significant downfall. The morning after, she encounters an entirely new disaster, and the solution she believed would pave her way out unexpectedly places her in grave danger.

Episodes.Title: The Switch
Episodes.Description: Na-eon wakes up in the hospital, trapped in Eun-ho’s body. To figure out exactly what happened, she continues living Eun-ho’s life and realizes that at Seongsu Agency, he has been assigned to Team Underdog, a team full of troublesome employees that is led by none other than Yoo-mi.

Episodes.Title: Team Underdog
Episodes.Description: Na-eon, who is in Eun-ho’s body, starts to organize Team Underdog to get to work. However, her efforts are stifled by Yoo-mi’s plans to keep Eun-ho in check, which deepens the war of nerves between Na-eon and Yoo-mi. Meanwhile, Na-eon thinks about how a soul swap between her and Eun-ho could have occurred.

Episodes.Title: Big-sized High Heels
Episodes.Description: Being trapped in Eun-ho's body, Na-eon is trying hard to track down the person who tried to kill her. After hearing from Dong-beom, she suggested making big-size shoes for drag queens, and it was a huge success. Meanwhile, Na-eon receives a call from the hospital, and she sees the guy with the rabbit mask there.

Episodes.Title: Let's Kiss
Episodes.Description: In a TV interview, Yoo-mi claims that Na-eon simply took a fail and she didn't commit suicide because of the company. Meanwhile, Na-eon wakes up from a coma. In order to switch the soul back, Eun-ho suggests kissing each other.

Episodes.Title: Na-eon's Return
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho, who is trapped in Na-eon's body, returns to Seongsu Agency and becomes the manager of Team Underdog. The team is given a project to work on while Eun-ho and Na-eon try to figure out the culprit behind their incident.

Episodes.Title: The Pop-up Store
Episodes.Description: Team Underdog continues to work on the Girlish branding project and prepares to open a pop-up store. However, Team One of Seongsu Agency tries to get in the way and ruin the project. Meanwhile, Na-eon and Eun-ho think of ways of evade Team One's attempts.

Episodes.Title: Who's Behind Ms. Do?
Episodes.Description: Yoo-mi goes to check out Na-eon's pop-up store. She expected it to be shabby and a failure, but the store was a huge success, and Na-eon's team even saved up a lot of budget. Feeling frustrated, she goes to meet someone who has been behind her, and Eun-ho follows her. Meanwhile, Yoo-mi tells Eun-ho about an upcoming project.

Episodes.Title: The New Project
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho accepts the new project, and while doing so, Team Underdog also gets a chance to compete. Na-eon and her team go out for market research, and they run into Jenny. Meanwhile, Eun-ho asks Yoo-mi to make an appointment with Nam Yoon-hyuk.

Episodes.Title: A Secret Weapon
Episodes.Description: Both Yoo-mi and Na-eon are working hard on the rebranding project. Inspired by Jenny, Na-eon comes up with an innovative idea. Meanwhile, Yoo-mi has a secret weapon for her project, and that is Yoon Nam-hyuk, the sexy symbol of this generation.

Episodes.Title: Mood
Episodes.Description: Seongsu Agency and Segye Group are in the headlines of a scandalous situation because of Yoon-hyuk, the soju model of Yoo-mi's rebranding project. Yoo-mi is done for, and Na-eon's non-alcoholic drink concept has become a huge success.

Episodes.Title: Souls Get Switched Back
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho gets a mysterious message and he goes to the restaurant that is mentioned in the text. He sees Director Han there. All of a sudden, both Eun-ho and Na-eon have a serious headache, and their souls get switched back. Meanwhile, Na-eon finds out that Director Han is the guy behind Yoo-mi.

Episodes.Title: Na-eon Becomes the Team Manager
Episodes.Description: Na-eon becomes the manager of Team One for her successful rebranding of Segye Soju. She assigns new projects to the teams, and she takes the HQ Motors project which will lead her to Director Han. Meanwhile, Team Underdog is in charge of rebranding an old motel building.

Episodes.Title: A Bouquet of White Flowers
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho and Na-eon switch souls whenever they hear a particular sound of a wind chime that gives them a headache. Meanwhile, Na-eon finds Eun-ho suspicious as she sees the messages he got from Director Han.

Episodes.Title: Na-eon's Past
Episodes.Description: It turns out that Eun-ho works for Director Han in order to know the truth about an incident that happened five years ago. Na-eon feels frustrated. She meets Eun-ho at Mangyeon Temple, and Eun-ho gives her a week to reveal the truth. Meanwhile, there's a strange warning on the company's bulletin board.

Episodes.Title: Bandi Candle
Episodes.Description: Da-eun, Eun-ho's girlfriend, had a talent for making candles. Five years ago, Na-eon and Eun-ho bumped into each other accidentally at Segye Group, and their materials for branding presentations got mixed up. Just like that, Da-eun's ideas of Bandi Candles were in Na-eon's hands and Na-eon turned Da-eun's ideas into hers.

Episodes.Title: The Truth
Episodes.Description: Yoo-mi overhears the conversation between Na-eon and Eun-ho. She finds out the secret that they went through a soul switch and wants to use this secret to bring down Na-eon. Meanwhile, Na-eon wants to find out what evidence Director Han has in his hands. In order to do that, she will have to secure the deal with HQ Motors.

Episodes.Title: Coexistence
Episodes.Description: Segye International and Seongsu Agency are up for a big match. Before the presentation, Eun-ho gives something to Na-eon, and Na-eon reveals that Director Han has stolen High Jet’s idea. They join hands to bring down Director Han. Meanwhile, Eun-ho discovers a shocking clip from his hard drive.

Episodes.Title: Workshop
Episodes.Description: Na-eon holds a workshop, but Eun-ho refuses to join. Eun-ho can’t forgive himself for blaming Na-eon the whole time and he decides to resign. Meanwhile, Na-eon confesses to Eun-ho. They decide to find the person who tried to kill Na-eon together.

Episodes.Title: The Rabbit
Episodes.Description: The evidence of Jung-woo trying to kill Na-eon is now in Na-eon’s hands. She makes Jung-woo confess and it was Hee-jung who was behind everything. Meanwhile, Na-eon and her team are going to make Hee-jung do something bad and get new evidence.

Episodes.Title: The Truth
Episodes.Description: At Hee-jung's inauguration, Na-eon reveals the ultimate truth. Hee-jung and Jung-woo are arrested for their wrongdoings. Meanwhile, Na-eon becomes the new CEO of Seongsu Agency. However, Eun-ho wants some time and disappears.

Entries.Title: The Trunk
Entries.Description: Noh In-ji receives her next field wife assignment. Han Jeong-won struggles with his separation from ex-wife Lee Seo-yeon and an impending second marriage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Noh In-ji receives her next field wife assignment. Han Jeong-won struggles with his separation from ex-wife Lee Seo-yeon and an impending second marriage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Five years ago, after her fiancé vanishes, In-ji has a fateful meeting. In the present, she learns more about her new husband and his ex-wife.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jeong-won slowly warms up to his new wife. Sensing a change, Lee Seo-yeon tries to make her ex crack. Meanwhile, someone from In-ji's past resurfaces.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: As In-ji creates a homey life and instills peace around Jeong-won, he grapples with his growing desire for her. Seo-yeon can't handle losing control.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jeong-won learns about Eom Tae-seong and offers help, but In-ji rebuffs him. Seo-yeon gets a grim warning. Later, the wife and ex-wife clash at a funeral.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Seo-yeon demands an end to their tangled relationship, and In-ji boldly confronts her. Meanwhile, a mysterious figure lurks near Seo Do-ha's apartment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Shocked by the bloody corridor, In-ji steps into Do-ha's apartment with trepidation. Who or what will she find, and will she finally get closure?

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After learning of Seo-yeon's betrayal, Jeong-won cuts their toxic ties. In-ji decides to end everything and invites Tae-seong for a decisive moment.

Entries.Title: The Tale of Lady Ok
Entries.Description: Goodeoki, a skilled slave, while preparing to escape from her master's house with her sick father hides in Seo In's home. Misunderstandings with Seo In's fiancée, So Hye, lead to a humiliating punishment. Meanwhile, Lady Ok Tae Young, returning from Qing, stays at an inn. How will the fates of Goodeoki and Ok Tae Young intertwine as they navigate their challenges?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Goodeoki, a skilled slave, while preparing to escape from her master's house with her sick father hides in Seo In's home. Misunderstandings with Seo In's fiancée, So Hye, lead to a humiliating punishment. Meanwhile, Lady Ok Tae Young, returning from Qing, stays at an inn. How will the fates of Goodeoki and Ok Tae Young intertwine as they navigate their challenges?

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Goodeoki, who now identifies herself as Ok Tae Young to conceal her identity, hides in a secluded annex. Wearing a veil to seek revenge for the late Tae Young, she assists in capturing a group of bandits who raided the inn. The discerning madam Han begins to take an interest in Goodeoki's cleverness. Meanwhile, Seo In, now a storyteller named Chon Seung Hwi, reappears before Goodeoki. Can the two recognize each other under their new names?

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Tae Young accuses the Baek Do Gwang family of killing Baekyi, but finds herself up against their claims of innocence as they frame Mak Sim. In her desperation, Tae Young scales the government office's wall, only to come face-to-face with Yun Gyeom, who looks identical to Seung Hwi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tae Young joins Gyu Jin to rescue abducted children, aided by a masked man she suspects is Yun Gyeom. Her doubts deepen upon finding a mark on his shoulder. Meanwhile, rumors about a traitor in Cheongsu County spread.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Things get worse for Tae Young as she loses her people one after another. When Mak Sim is at the risk of being sold at a slave market, Tae Young steps in to save her. Meanwhile, Seung Hwi returns to Cheongsu County after hearing about Tae Young's tragedy, and Tae Young finally decides to make her move to restore everything.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Tae Young and Seung Hwi fall into a trap as they try to rescue abducted children. As Chief Lee's misdeeds and evil schemes unveil, Tae Young cannot hold in her rage and does what she can as a legal advocate. Will Tae Young be able to clear Gyu Jin's name and protect her family?

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Seung Hwi cannot hide his love for Tae Young once they reunite after a long time. They spend a dreamlike time together, and finally, confront their feelings for each other. Unfortunately, their time to part ways is just around the corner. Meanwhile, Mi Ryeong plans to take revenge against Tae Young while she is away, and Tae Young is terrified at a tragic news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After Yun Gyeom is found dead, rumors about Tae Young spread in Cheongsu County. Tae Young loses her place in the office as she is mistreated for becoming a widow. Things are about to get worse when she is nearly prohibited from leaving the house. Meanwhile, Lady Song, who is all about taking revenge on Tae Young, tries to use Mi Ryeong to fulfill her desire.

Entries.Title: Love Your Enemy
Entries.Description: Seok Ji-won and Yoon Ji-won reunite after 18 years, as chairman and gym teacher of the same school.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Seok Ji-won and Yoon Ji-won reunite after 18 years, as chairman and gym teacher of the same school.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: At a staff dinner, Seok Ji-won makes a bet with Yoon Ji-won over whether the "crazy lilac" will bloom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Seok Ji-won and Yoon Ji-won meet at the pond where they used to go on dates but get into another fight.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Yoon Ji-won recalls her past with Gong Moon-soo, and Seok Ji-won ruins the inauguration ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The two families fight over the golf course, while Yoon Ji-won secretly nurses Seok Ji-won's cold.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Yoon Ji-won becomes furious when Seok Ji-won forgets their kiss from the night before.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Seok Ji-won and Yoon Ji-won begin dating and discover old letters and texts they had sent each other.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Seok Ji-won hopes to enjoy a workshop with Yoon Ji-won. He gets anxious by the rumors of Gong Moon-soo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Seok Ji-won and Yoon Ji-won's relationship becomes public and starts to cause trouble.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Seok Ji-won continues to plan his proposal, but unexpected situations keep getting in the way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Seok Ji-won uncovers shocking facts about Ji Gyung-hun's corruption.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: As it snows on Christmas Eve just like it did 18 years ago, Yoon Ji-won takes a trip down memory lane.

Entries.Title: The Two Sisters
Entries.Description: Do Eun, Yi Chul's mistress, exposes herself and their baby on her social media on purpose, and the whole world finds out about their affair. Ji Chang and Hye Won are on Soo Hyang's side for the divorce trial and try their best to comfort her. Meanwhile, Ji Chang prepares a gift for Hye Won before their wedding.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Do Eun, Yi Chul's mistress, exposes herself and their baby on her social media on purpose, and the whole world finds out about their affair. Ji Chang and Hye Won are on Soo Hyang's side for the divorce trial and try their best to comfort her. Meanwhile, Ji Chang prepares a gift for Hye Won before their wedding.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ji Chang promises Hye Won to find her long-lost sister, Hye Ji, no matter what. Hye Won discovers Yi Chul has been embezzling company funds under a shell company for two years. Meanwhile, Do Eun is curious about Ji Chang's fiancé and wants to meet her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Do Eun plans to meet her soon-to-be daughter-in-law and rear-ends Hye Won's car to get things started. She then buys an art piece from her gallery. To learn more about the painting, Do Eun offers to have dinner together. At the dinner, Eun notices the pendant necklace around Hye Won's neck that she once shared with her biological sister.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Do Eun realizes Hye Won is her biological sister, whom she separated from when they were young. Meanwhile, Hye Won is confused about why Do Eun left in a rush from their dinner. Later, Hye Won learns Do Eun is Yi Chul's mistress and becomes furious.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Kyung Ja appears unexpectedly and ruins Hye Won and Ji Chang's wedding while Do Eun watches from the sidelines. However, Do Eun sees Min Tae, her father, and she begins to remember the past. Meanwhile, Myung Ae can't believe the disgrace Hye Won brought to the family and scolds Ji Chang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After ruining Hye Won's wedding, Do Eun plots another scheme to bring her down with Kyung Ja. Hye Won and Ji Chang return home without going on a honeymoon, and Hye Won even sees Do Eun in her dream. While Myung Ae gives Hye Won a hard time at home, Do Eun sends a text message to Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Do Eun suggests to Hye Won that they meet and talk in person. Do Eun sends her a photo of her necklace to convince her that she is her younger sister, Hye Ji. Hye Won waits for Hye Ji at the mineral spring, but a man shows up instead of Hye Ji.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Do Eun becomes furious after the protest in front of the Boram Childcare Facility. Do Eun suspects Hye Won is the one responsible for the protest and calls her to meet. Meanwhile, breaking news of Yi Chul's large donation to the Boram Childcare Facility by using a shell company airs, along with Do Eun's position in the facility.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Hye Won is disappointed after learning that the phone number that said it was Hye Ji is from a burner phone. Meanwhile, Myung Ae visits the temple and discovers from the monk that Yi Chul will have another child of great importance, and Do Eun takes off to get some air.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: After learning that Soo Hyang will be holding a talk concert, Do Eun appears at the event and asks a question during the Q and A time. Hye Won is astounded by Do Eun's appearance and tries to remedy the situation. Meanwhile, Soo Hyang realizes the woman is Do Eun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Since Young Ju and Jang Gun cannot reach Do Eun anymore, they change their target to Hye Won. To bring Hye Won down, Do Eun runs a background check on Judan Foundation for Arts and finds out about Dan Ung, who signed with the gallery. Not long after Do Eun's confrontation, another shocking news about Soo Hyang breaks out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Dan Ung frames Soo Hyang for sexual assault and disappears. No matter how hard Hye Won tries to reach him, he is nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, Ji Chang suspects Do Eun, so he wants to meet her in person to reveal the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Ji Chang encounters Do Eun directly, only to find that she doesn't match the image of recklessness he had anticipated. Upon Ji Chang's return, Hye Won expresses her disappointment in his apparent favoring of Do Eun. Meanwhile, Soo Hyang intends to pay Attorney Song a visit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Hye Won tries to find Dan Ung, who has gone out of contact, to no avail. She returns home but gets further frustrated when Ji Chang thinks the opposite about Do Eun. To make matters worse, Do Eun tells Yi Chul about what Hye Won did to her when they coincidentally met and gets Hye Won in trouble.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Hye Won and Ji Chang are traumatized by Yi Chul and Soo Hyang's divorce, and Ji Chang starts to resent Do Eun even more. However, Myung Ae invites Do Eun over to their place. Meanwhile, Jang Gun and Young Ju visit Hyangdan Agency to find Hye Won and run into San Deul.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Hye Won and Do Eun meet again when Do Eun visits her in-laws at home. Do Eun shares surprising news, and Hye Won feels uncomfortable around her. The memory of their childhood unexpectedly overtakes Do Eun, but she tries to pull herself together for revenge. Meanwhile, Hye Won and Ji Chang grow apart after Do Eun joins the family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Hye Won is stunned to learn that Dan Ung has departed the country, particularly shocked when she discovers his destination is Mauritius. Do Eun's fake pregnancy approaches revelation as she's guided, somewhat reluctantly, to the OB-GYN. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon establishes a law office conveniently close to San Deul’s tteokbokki spot.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Do Eun uses her wits to overcome the crisis of her fake pregnancy getting exposed. Meanwhile, Hye Won searches for evidence that Do Eun was behind the incident involving Soo Hyang. She resorts to apologizing to Do Eun to get the answers she needs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Hye Won finally meets Lim Dan Ung face-to-face. After acquiring the evidence that would clear Soo Hyang's name, she hands it to Soo Hyang. However, Soo Hyang tells Hye Won that she will take care of it and calls Do Eun to meet.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Now that Soo Hyang has the recorder from Dan Ung, she decides to talk to Do Eun in person. She asks Hye Won to keep it a secret from Ji Chang as she wants to handle it on her own. When Soo Hyang calls Do Eun to confront her with the evidence, Do Eun flips out and asks for forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Before Soo Hyang exposes the truth, she passes away due to a heart attack. Do Eun brazenly attends the funeral in a mourning dress, which makes Hye Won and Ji Chang infuriated. Hye Won quickly leaves the funeral after she gets a call from Dan Ung, and Do Eun tries to stop her. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon attends the funeral after hearing the news and runs into Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Hye Won heads directly to meet Lim Dan Ung, but upon arrival, she is met with a disturbing scene. Despite the confusion, Hye Won gathers her resolve to uncover the truth behind the suspicious deaths. Meanwhile, Myung Ae instructs Hye Won and Ji Chang not to conceive a child until Do Eun delivers her baby, but it may be a bit too late.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: After bumping into Hye Won at the pharmacy, Sung Yoon notices that Hye Won is pregnant. However, she doesn't recognize him and goes on her way. Meanwhile, Do Eun moves in with the family and begins to get under Hye Won's skin. Their new life under the same roof begins, but Hye Won has no intentions of giving in to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Young Ju and Min Tae run into each other and ask about their daughters, Hye Won and Hye Ji. Min Tae lies to her by saying Hye Won is studying abroad to protect Hye Won from her. Meanwhile, Do Eun lies to Ji Chang about what happened between Soo Hyang and her at the hotel, and now, she wants to set up a fake miscarriage and put the blame on Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Do Eun gets anxious after she finds out Hye Won is pregnant. Moreover, Myung Ae makes it clear to Do Eun that she will only let her join the family after she gives birth to Yi Chul's child. Therefore, instead of faking the pregnancy, Do Eun changes her plan to actually get pregnant this time. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon wants to help Hye Won with Dan Ung's case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Do Eun loses her mind as her plan falls through. Now that she cannot get pregnant, her hatred for Hye Won grows even bigger and threatens her for having a baby. Hye Won and Ji Chang quarrel over Dan Ung's case, and Myung Ae orders Hye Won to retrieve Dan Ung's art pieces back from their family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Ji Chang learns about Hye Won's pregnancy indirectly and reacts coldly. Hye Won tells him she didn't have the courage to tell him the news, but it doesn't work. Meanwhile, Do Eun communicates with a baby broker so that she can continue to hide her fake pregnancy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Hye Won is upset at how things between Ji Chang have become regarding her pregnancy. She talks to Min Sook about it to feel better. Meanwhile, Do Eun sees San Deul talking with Hye Won and realizes he is her brother and the person who had been looking for her. She makes up her mind to get close to him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Hye Won and Ji Chang are at odds over matters at both work and home. Ji Chang wants Hye Won to let go of Dan Ung's case, but Hye Won is not willing to give up on it. Meanwhile, now that Do Eun realizes San Deul is in love with her, she tries to make use of him to get revenge on Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Do Eun spikes the porridge San Deul got for Hye Won. Hye Won gets suspicious of the way Do Eun acts, but Ji Chang thinks she is being overly sensitive. Meanwhile, Do Eun witnesses Hye Won and Sung Yoon together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Min Tae comes to see Hye Won at her place and runs into Do Eun. When Min Tae realizes that Do Eun is his long-lost daughter, Hye Ji, Do Eun threatens him to stay quiet. Meanwhile, Hye Won asks Do Eun about what happened between Min Tae and her earlier in the day, and Do Eun shoves her as hard as she can so that she falls down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: San Deul falls for Do Eun's trap and makes reservations with Hye Won for fish porridge. She also suggests taking Sung Yoon along for the trip. Meanwhile, Do Eun brings up Sung Yoon's name with Yi Chul regarding the attorney position at the company.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Hye Won and the party of people headed for lunch fall into Do Eun's trap, and they all get taken to the emergency. Meanwhile, Min Tae meets Young Ju with money to keep her away from Hye Won, but Young Ju makes a scene. Just then, Min Tae's phone shows Hye Won calling that Young Ju sees.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: The whole family finds out Hye Won is pregnant, and Do Eun throws a fit at Kyung Ja as both Hye Won and her baby survived the car accident. However, Ji Chang and Hye Won's misunderstanding grows deeper after the porridge incident as Do Eun planned. Meanwhile, Min Tae worries about Hye Ji and waits for her to reach him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Hye Won figures out Do Eun is not pregnant, but she decides to stay quiet and keep an eye on her. Ji Chang straightforwardly asks Sung Yoon if he has feelings for Hye Won. Meanwhile, Hye Won runs into Young Ju at the bank.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: Min Tae comes by Do Eun's place to ask for forgiveness, and Hye Won advises San Deul to stop seeing Angela. Sung Yoon and Hye Won look for Do Eun's pawn to expose her for instigating murder. Meanwhile, Ji Chang's childhood friend, Ji Eun, joins him for his next project.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Sung Yoon keeps his promise to Hye Won and tails Do Eun to find evidence. Luckily, he follows her to the OB-GYN clinic Do Eun attends and discovers her fake pregnancy. After hearing this from Sung Yoon, Hye Won takes the evidence and confronts Do Eun to make a crushing deal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: As Hye Won confronts Do Eun with her infertility diagnosis, Do Eun confesses to Hye Won that she is her sister, Hye Ji. Now that the inevitable has come, Do Eun worries anxiously about all her heinous deeds and visits Sung Yoon. Meanwhile, Ji Chang's friend Ji Eun appears.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Hye Won and Sung Yoon pressure Do Eun to find Kyung Ja, and Do Eun pays Young Ju to help her with her schemes. After Do Eun discovers that Ji Eun and Ji Chang are close friends even at work, she decides to use Ji Eun to tear Hye Won and Ji Chang apart.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: After the elevator accident, Hye Won heads to her father's place to rest, and Ji Chang follows her to beg for forgiveness. Ji Chang finds out someone else sent the text message to Hye Won through Ji Eun's phone. Furthermore, Sung Yoon suspects Do Eun as the culprit behind the elevator accident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: The house turns upside down as Do Eun's fake pregnancy and infertility are revealed. The whole family realizes they have been completely fooled by Do Eun, so they kick her out of their house. Do Eun ends up barging into Min Tae's place, and Hye Won lets Ji Chang know that Do Eun is her long-lost sister, Hye Ji.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Do Eun runs away, but Hye Won notices her missing and chases up to her. Shortly after, Min Tae comes to save Do Eun but gets into a hit-and-run accident, losing his life. Draped in sorrow, Hye Won swears at Do Eun she won't stop until she takes her down. Meanwhile, Do Eun blackmails Ji Chang for money.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Hye Won tells Ji Chang that she can't live with him, and Ji Chang tries to figure out how he can protect both the company and Hye Won. Meanwhile, Do Eun trembles in fear when she learns that Hye Won might get her hands on the evidence of her murder instigation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Do Eun finds out Hye Won has the recorder and she is about to head to the police station to report Do Eun. Do Eun steals a delivery truck and follows Hye Won to stop her. Therefore, Hye Won ends up losing consciousness in the middle of the road.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: Hye Won gets disappointed in Ji Chang again as she realizes he stopped the investigation for the car accident. However, he feigns ignorance and even gets mad at her for suspecting him. Meanwhile, Yi Chul promises Do Eun to run away together, and Myung Ae tells Hye Won to leave Ji Chang and her son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: Hye Won witnesses Ji Chang having an affair with Ji Eun. Hye Won wants a divorce, but Ji Chang is not letting her leave him easily. Do Eun heads to YJ resort that's under renovation to meet Yi Chul. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon runs into Ji Chang at a memorial park and follows him to find out what he is up to.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: Hye Won rushes out to look for Ji Chang, but she witnesses Hye Ji get into a disastrous hit-and-run accident. Hye Ji goes in for surgery, but she falls into a coma. Meanwhile, Ji Chang goes missing, and Hye Won worries he might have to do something with Hye Ji's accident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: After the autopsy, Hye Won learns that Ji Chang died from a hit-and-run accident. With that information, Hye Won and Sung Yoon search for the culprit behind Ji Chang's murder. Meanwhile, fake news about Hye Won and Sung Yoon's affair surfaces and causes mayhem for Hye Won in Ji Chang's household.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: Do Eun miraculously wakes up after the car accident, but loses her memory as Do Eun. Furthermore, the doctor mentions that she also shows signs of delusion, but Hye Won is not sure if she is delusional or just lying. Five years later, Jun Mo flies back to Korea and looks forward to meeting Hye Won after a long time.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: Do Eun gets a part-time job as a cleaner and remembers something about Yi Chul. Even when Yi Chul is locked up in prison, he orders his assistant to keep an eye on Do Eun and waits for her to regain her memory. Meanwhile, Hye Won and Sung Yoon have a meeting with Jun Mo at Hye Won's office.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51
Episodes.Description: To get Jun Mo to invest in YJ Group, Sung Yoon decides to quit as Jun Mo requested. However, Hye Won tries to come up with a strategy to keep Sung Yoon by her side. Meanwhile, Ji Eun wants to bring Hye Won down through Jun Mo, and Do Eun visits Yi Chul to find out about her past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 52
Episodes.Description: Jun Mo offers Sung Yoon a chance to work together, but Sung Yoon feels his proposal is a trap. Hye Ji worries she might end up in jail and attempts to feel out Hye Won if she has the voice recording of her as evidence. Meanwhile, Yi Chul threatens Hye Won with the clause in her deal regarding her son and pushes her to get him out of prison.

Episodes.Title: Episode 53
Episodes.Description: Hye Ji starts to remember things in fragments, and Hye Won looks for a way to force Hye Ji into hospitalization. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon gets his hands on a dashcam video that shows Cha Ji Eun at the scene of Ji Chang's death. Later, they track her down to get her to confess.

Episodes.Title: Episode 54
Episodes.Description: Yi Chul is released from prison, and Do Eun makes a deal with him by giving him information about Jun Mo. The wife of Assemblyman Cha Sang Beom, Ji Eun's mother, visits Hye Won to warn her about her revenge. She firmly believes that Hye Won is responsible for Ji Eun's death. Yi Chul also joins her in kicking Hye Won out of YJ Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 55
Episodes.Description: Do Eun tries to find the voice recorder and get rid of it before Hye Won does as she realizes that Hye Won is planning to lock her up in a closed ward. Do Eun gets closer to Jun Mo as Yi Chul tells her to and stalks him to find his weakness and report it back to Yi Chul.

Episodes.Title: Episode 56
Episodes.Description: Young Ju tails Hye Won as Do Eun told her to, and Hye Won finds the voice recorder that Ji Chang hid at the memorial hall. However, someone hits her in the head from behind and steals the recorder. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon finally confesses his feelings to Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 57
Episodes.Description: Jun Mo appeals to attract Hye Won with his whole heart, but Hye Won pushes him away yet again. Meanwhile, Yi Chul and Hye Ji continue to meet for each other's benefit, and Jun Mo and Sung Yoon meet for Hye Won's sake while closing the gap between them little by little.

Episodes.Title: Episode 58
Episodes.Description: Hye Won uses Kyung Ja in her plans to get her way with Hye Ji. Yi Chul determines to get YJ Group back into his hands and starts to win over the directors. Later, Hye Won asks Jun Mo for a favor at his house, and she runs into someone shocking.

Episodes.Title: Episode 59
Episodes.Description: Hye Ji barges into Jun Mo's apartment and confronts Hye Won when she realizes Hye Won was behind Kyung Ja's act. As Yi Chul and Hye Ji continue to threaten her with her son, she finds a safe place to hide the voice recorder. Then Hye Ji breaks into Hye Won's home to find it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 60
Episodes.Description: Hye Ji manages to snatch away the voice recorder from Hye Won and destroys it. Now that the crucial evidence of her crime is gone, Hye Ji approaches Yi Chul and makes a deal to get rid of Hye Won. Meanwhile, Yi Chul prepares for the board meeting as he is nominated as a new director for the vacant position.

Episodes.Title: Episode 61
Episodes.Description: After Yi Chul realizes he is in the fourth stage of glioblastoma, he decides to use Do Eun to retrieve YJ Group and his grandson from Hye Won. Therefore, he gets back together with Do Eun and brings her home. Furthermore, he takes Yong Ki away, which makes Hye Won lose her mind.

Episodes.Title: Episode 62
Episodes.Description: Recognizing Jun Mo's understanding of his condition, Yi Chul decides to return Yong Ki to Hye Won. Curiously, he ponders why Jun Mo hasn't disclosed his illness to Hye Won. Meanwhile, Hye Ji is startled when she confuses Soo Jung, Soo Hyang’s twin sister, for Soo Hyang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 63
Episodes.Description: Soo Jung takes Hye Won's side and intimidates Hye Ji to empower Hye Won in the household. Although Hye Ji is irritated by how things are turning, she gives Hye Won the key to Jun Mo's house and the passcode to his safe that contains secrets to Jun Mo's plan. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon reveals a suspicious fact as to why Jun Mo approached YJ Group to invest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 64
Episodes.Description: Hye Won finds the document about the sale decision for YJ Group in Jun Mo's safe and realizes that he is about to betray her. However, it's part of Jun Mo's plan to dub Yi Chul and Do Eun. Hye Won is deeply hurt and blames herself for trusting Jun Mo too quickly. Meanwhile, Do Eun tries to befriend Soo Jung to get what she wants.

Episodes.Title: Episode 65
Episodes.Description: Jun Mo finds out Yi Chul and Ja Young plan to cancel his investment and drive Hye Won out of YJ Group. Instead of removing the hidden camera Do Eun installed at his apartment, he uses it to dupe Yi Chul and Do Eun. Meanwhile, Yi Chul tries to appoint Do Eun to the design renewal team, even though Hye Won disapproves it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 66
Episodes.Description: Do Eun realizes Jun Mo and Hye Won are putting on a show using the video feed to deceive Yi Chul. However, instead of letting Yi Chul know about it, she meets Jun Mo and Hye Won first. Meanwhile, Sung Yoon visits his father to ask for help finding an investor for YJ Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 67
Episodes.Description: Sung Yoon meets Yi Chul and pulls out the patent rejection document to make him an offer that shocks him. Meanwhile, Hye Won and Jun Mo have a wonderful time with Yong Ki, and later, Sung Yoon shows up at Jun Mo's house to admit his defeat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 68
Episodes.Description: After reading his disciplinary summons back to the head office in the States, Jun Mo learns that Yi Chul was the one who set him up and departs. Meanwhile, Hye Ji makes a different deal with Yi Chul, and Hye Won faces dismissal from the company as Yi Chul takes Yong Ki away from her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 69
Episodes.Description: Hye Won loses everything, including Yong Ki, and gets kicked out of Yi Chul's house. While Hye Won looks for ways to get her son back, Hye Ji looks after him. A day before the emergency board meeting, Sung Yoon hands over a recording he made after meeting Yi Chul to Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 70
Episodes.Description: With the help of Jun Mo, Hye Won gets Yong Ki back from Yi Chul. Even though Yi Chul manages to push Hye Won out and become the president of YJ Group, he cannot celebrate it to the fullest as his illness gets worse each day. Meanwhile, Hye Ji is furious at Yi Chul for giving up on Yong Ki easily and decides to take him back from Hye Won.

Episodes.Title: Episode 71
Episodes.Description: Hye Ji visits Yong Ki at Hye Won's place and finds out Yi Chul gave up the parental rights to Hye Won. Now that Hye Ji has the key to the safety box at the bank in the Bahamas, she plans to kidnap Yong Ki and run away with Yi Chul's fortunes to restructure Yong Ki's memories.

Episodes.Title: Episode 72
Episodes.Description: Hye Ji disappears with Yong Ki to the Bahamas, leaving Hye Won in despair. Hye Won desperately searches for Yong Ki with Jun Mo while Yi Chang recovers from an overdose in the hospital. Meanwhile, Hye Ji begins manipulating Yong Ki's memories to think she is his mother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 73
Episodes.Description: When Hye Ji shows up at the hospital ward, Yi Chul wakes up from the shock that made him unconscious and shows signs of recovery. However, he has no choice but to follow Hye Ji's plot, knowing she has his money. Meanwhile, Hye Won desperately tries to restore Yong Ki's memories but learns that only the person who brainwashed him can do it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 74
Episodes.Description: Yi Chul takes Hye Won's side to stop Hye Ji from committing another crime using his money and family. Furthermore, Yi Chul's condition suddenly gets worse and he needs emergency surgery. Meanwhile, Hye Ji realizes Yi Chul is hiding something from her, so she joins hands with Ja Young.

Episodes.Title: Episode 75
Episodes.Description: Yong Ki regains his memory, and Hye Ji gets arrested for abduction and kidnapping of a minor. However, Hye Ji hires Sung Yoon's father, Attorney Baek Myung Chul, and he is determined to charge Hye Won for libel. Meanwhile, Jun Mo asks Sung Yoon for help as he finds out what Ja Young and Hye Ji are up to.

Episodes.Title: Episode 76
Episodes.Description: Sung Yoon manages to steal the phone, but the recording of Hye Ji's confession is gone. Jun Mo realizes Hye Ji will leave the detention center with Ja Young's help as she has 50 million dollars of bearer bonds as her wings. Meanwhile, Hye Won comes back home to see Hye Ji and tells her Ja Young is about to find out she instigated the murder.

Episodes.Title: Episode 77
Episodes.Description: Hye Won successfully tracks down the housekeeper at the very hotel where Soo Hyang's tragic demise occurred. Armed with this crucial piece of information, Hye Won puts pressure on Hye Ji to return the bonds. Meanwhile, Hye Ji takes matters into her own hands and meets with Ja Young, adamantly demanding a director position within the YJ Group

Entries.Title: A Killer Paradox
Entries.Description: Flailing at life, Lee Tang panics after he kills a man after work. Soon, Jang Nan-gam is on the case — discovering a disturbing truth about the victim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Flailing at life, Lee Tang panics after he kills a man after work. Soon, Jang Nan-gam is on the case — discovering a disturbing truth about the victim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: A mysterious woman approaches Tang, claiming to know his secret and begins to blackmail him. The weight of his actions starts taking a mental toll.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Nan-gam struggles to find clear answers as he investigates the latest deaths. After connecting with an enigmatic figure, Tang decides to turn himself in.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Wondering if the same killer is behind all the murders, Nan-gam probes Roh Bin for clues, leading to an unlikely partnership between the two.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: As Nan-gam notices a clear pattern among the recent murders, he searches for Tang — unaware of another mysterious man who is doing the same.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: In his search for Tang, Song Chon confronts Bin — who desperately turns to Nan-gam for help. But Tang agrees to meet with Chon, who has a proposition.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Nan-gam comes face to face with Chon, who recognizes him from the past. As Bin and Tang plan their final escape, Bin receives a menacing phone call.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The endgame to the chase leads to a final fight — and it's everyone versus Chon. In the process, Nan-gam finally learns the truth about his father.

Entries.Title: Su Ji and U Ri
Entries.Description: Su Ji is a national psychiatrist and a star doctor at Haedeul Hospital who is always busy from morning to night. Besides, her sister, Na Young, is an eating show reporter who dreams of becoming a news anchor. Meanwhile, U Ri gets discharged from the military and heads straight to Haedeul Hospital.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Su Ji is a national psychiatrist and a star doctor at Haedeul Hospital who is always busy from morning to night. Besides, her sister, Na Young, is an eating show reporter who dreams of becoming a news anchor. Meanwhile, U Ri gets discharged from the military and heads straight to Haedeul Hospital.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Following a promising Bibi Roll investment briefing, Jang Soo is optimistic about advancing his position in the restaurant industry. Meanwhile, Do Young finds himself at a police station after a rap battle confrontation with his longtime rival. Meanwhile, Su Ji is tasked with hosting the 50th-anniversary celebration of Haedeul Hospital, while U Ri expresses disappointment with her tendency to prioritize other concerns over patients.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: U Ri spends his day dealing with the persistent requests of Su Ji's patients and their caretakers. Meanwhile, Su Ji grapples with memories from her childhood that unexpectedly resurface at The Courtyard House. Unaware of Su Ji's inner turmoil, U Ri becomes irritated upon discovering that Su Ji has discarded the sorghum rice cake balls gifted by Sun Young. Meanwhile, Jin Tae's birthday is marked by Ma Ri's indifference, dampening the festivities.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: U Ri gets swamped with work because of Su Ji's busy schedule. It only angers him when he sees her posing for a promotional photo shoot. Jang Soo finds it strange he can't get a hold of Mr. Gong, and Na Young asks Su Ji to help her get lessons from a famous announcer. Meanwhile, Hyun Sung returns home after ending his long life in the US.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ma Ri and Hyun Sung visit the temple to pay their respects to Ma Ri's late father, but Hyun Sung senses there is someone else Ma Ri is mourning. U Ri takes a crushing kick from Su Ji and throws out his back. Meanwhile, Na Young gets invited to dinner with the chief director of the broadcasting station.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Doo Ri faces a financial dilemma when she's unfairly forced to foot the bill for damaged clothes. Ma Ri asserts control over Jin Tae by unilaterally altering 50th-anniversary plans. As Na Young's cheek swells with a fiery red hue, Yoon Ja's frustration escalates beyond harsh words, intensifying the tension with Su Ji.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Doo Ri refuses to let her hard-earned money slip away without actively seeking out the one accountable. She initiates picketing outside the company's entrance. Following a pleasant dinner with his parents, Hyun Sung encounters Su Ji and U Ri seemingly enjoying themselves together at the restaurant. Meanwhile, Sun Young reflects on the tragic accident she experienced 27 years ago.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Na Young is enraged at Su Ji for not keeping her promise to arrange a lesson with Ms. Son. U Ri is troubled by Su Ji’s abrupt change in demeanor ever since he mentioned seeing her cry at the hospital. Jang Soo is anxious as he frets over Mr. Gong disappearing. Meanwhile, the highly anticipated 50th-anniversary celebration at Haedeul Hospital unexpectedly leads to a reunion with Su Ji's former friend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Jang Soo's Bibi Roll venture turns for the worse, and he faces unforeseen turmoil. Jung Soon and Sun Young worry about A Ra's entrance to school while still in their care. Meanwhile, Na Young can't stand to see Su Ji's success and becomes overly jealous of her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Hyun Sung and Su Ji say goodbye after their affection reunion. Na Young uses the handkerchief as an excuse and visits U Ri at the hospital. Sun Young gets an urgent call from A Ra's kindergarten that requires her appearance, and Jin Tae forces Hyun Sung to attend a piano recital. Meanwhile, the Haedeul Hospital's Psychiatry Department has a dinner get-together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Jin Tae suggests a joint interview to Ma Ri, as Jang Soo rushes to resolve the significant problem he's gotten into before Su Ji discovers it, leaving him in a state of panic. The events of last night lead to a tentative reconciliation between Su Ji and U Ri, though it quickly dissipates. Meanwhile, Hyun Sung is troubled by the man who answered Su Ji's phone call for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Jin Tae and Ma Ri stumble upon a heap of gimbap left by Hyun Sung and wonder for whom they are intended. Su Ji and Hyun Sung reminisce about their past while on a date. U Ri ends up telling Su Ji about Na Young's persistent inquiries about her the previous night, leaving Su Ji feeling uncomfortable. Meanwhile, Sun Young aims to play matchmaker between Woo Chang and the kindergarten teacher.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Jin Tae ignores Hyun Sung's intentions and pushes for him to meet a girl from a prestigious family. Yoon Ja suspects Jang Soo of having an affair and tails him, while Su Ji sees A Ra's yellow cape and recalls her young past. Meanwhile, Sun Young asks Woo Chang to spend the weekend together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Yoon Ja can't figure out what is with Jang Soo, but she still treats him like an ATM. Hyun Sung takes Su Ji as a defensive strategy to the piano recital that Jin Tae forced on him. Meanwhile, the Courtyard House family is ecstatic at the news of Woo Chang and Sun Young going on a date and cheer them on.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Woo Chang is taken aback to discover that Sun Young isn't his intended companion, but another person entirely. After a decade of holding on to it, Hyun Sung finally presents Su Ji with a gift. Na Young receives uplifting news as she learns she's made it to the finals of the audition. Do Young learns about the challenges his father has been facing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Na Young is frustrated because Su Ji always interrupts her moments alone with U Ri. Su Ji is enraged upon discovering that Na Young has rifled through her cherished possessions. Jang Soo and Do Young are engaged in undercover operations to apprehend the fleeing Mr. Gong. Su Ji is taken aback when she encounters Hyun Sung at the hospital, appearing to be someone she didn’t expect him to be.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Su Ji is shocked when she finds out that Hyun Sung is the new director at the hospital. Meanwhile, something about U Ri keeps bothering Hyun Sung, even though U Ri has zero interest in Su Ji. Ma Ri embarrasses Jin Tae at the company meeting while introducing the hospital’s new crucial business. Yoon Ja is suspicious of why Jang Soo and Do Young are always together throughout the day. Na Young bluntly tells U Ri that she likes him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Su Ji learns she was nominated to host the program Na Young desperately wanted, while Jang Soo deals with the severe aftermath of the fraud. At Handeul Hospital, Ma Ri and Jin Tae get into a heated discussion when their views on managing the hospital collide. Meanwhile, Na Young calls U Ri for solace after discovering her position as the host got lost to someone else.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Jin Tae sees Hyun Sung with Su Ji in front of the hospital, and Ma Ri discovers pictures of Hyun Sung with Su Ji. Yoon Ja tells Bok Sun that she saw someone who resembled Sun Young, while Jang Soo begins to chase down the partner that left him in shambles. Meanwhile, Na Young is shocked when she learns the identity of the person who took her host position.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Su Ji once again reveals a side of herself to U Ri that she had intended to keep hidden. Sun Young tends to Woo Chang, who falls ill due to her words. Hyun Sung becomes envious upon discovering Su Ji and U Ri napping in the same room during their night shift. Meanwhile, Jang Soo successfully locates Mr. Gong, only to encounter an unexpected obstacle.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: The Bibi Roll investors are causing a commotion at the hospital, insisting that Su Ji immediately settle her father's debt. Hyun Sung and U Ri intervene before Su Ji steps into the fray. Meanwhile, Jin Tae is displeased with Hyun Sung's public involvement, referring to him as Su Ji's fiance. Sun Young discovers the reason behind A Ra's fixation on fifty cents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Su Ji is stunned by the revelation of Hyun Sung's parents. Jin Tae and Ma Ri are shocked upon learning that Hyun Sung's return to Haedeul Hospital is primarily because of Su Ji. Na Young takes action to secure the new program's MC position, confronting the director directly. Meanwhile, U Ri responds to Na Young's confession.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: U Ri finds Na Young's behavior strange whenever Su Ji gets mentioned and believes she has a bizarre compulsive disorder against her. Hyun Sung confides in U Ri about how he feels about Su Ji, and Jang Soo's family prepares to move. Meanwhile, Jung Soon becomes furious when she sees a picture of A Ra, Woo Chang, and Sun Young together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Do Young takes on a part-time job to help the family, and Su Ji gets offered an exclusive contract with a huge signing bonus. Jung Soon can't stand the current relationship between Woo Chang and Sun Young and explodes in anger. Meanwhile, Jin Tae reveals his genuine feelings to his son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: U Ri intervenes to prevent Su Ji from suffering serious harm due to Na Young's actions. Na Young becomes aware that Su Ji's partner is the son of the owner of the Haedeul Foundation. Ma Ri is touched by Jin Tae's proposal to dedicate the new hospital center to her father. Meanwhile, the residents of The Courtyard House organize a family getaway to help calm Jung Soon's troubled emotions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: U Ri recognizes the individual in the video who received a slap from Su Ji. Seeking clarity on the incident, he arranges a meeting with Na Young. Sun Young harbors guilt over Jung Soon's choice to leave their home. Do Young stands up against those who criticize Su Ji solely based on the video. Hyun Sung feels disheartened as Su Ji continuously declines his offers of assistance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Understanding the harm the viral video is causing her career and seeing patients start to cancel appointments, Su Ji gets ready for a press conference to explain. Ma Ri organizes the press conference for Su Ji. Meanwhile, Do Young narrowly avoids trouble thanks to Doo Ri. Na Young feels more anxious as Su Ji's press conference approaches.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: An unexpected event during the press conference ruins Su Ji's image. Hyun Sung takes Su Ji, exhausted from the stress, to his officetel, where he lets her recuperate. Jin Tae suddenly learns that the Jihan Group wants to stop plans to build the research lab. Meanwhile, excitement fills the air at The Courtyard House because of Woo Chang's date.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Jin Tae orders Hyun Sung to step away from any affairs involving Su Ji, while Do Young and Doo Ri establish a debtor-creditor relationship on paper. U Ri goes to Hyun Sung's officetel to talk about Su Ji and sees traces of Su Ji everywhere. Meanwhile, Su Ji and Na Young get into another fight, but someone watches them in secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Su Ji gets humiliated by the protesters in front of the hospital, and U Ri saves her. Director Han decides to terminate Su Ji as her scandal is causing the whole hospital to suffer damage. Furthermore, Su Ji gets ready to make an official statement through her show, and another video of her goes viral on the internet.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Su Ji collapses in Sun Young's arms, and Sun Young takes her to the emergency room. Hyun Sung and Su Ji's family head over to the hospital as soon as they hear the news. U Ri visits her later on, but Hyun Sung warns him not to cross the line and sends him away. The next day, Sun Young stops by Su Ji's ward to get her food.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Jin Tae lets go of Su Ji from her position to deal with the issue that's getting out of hand. Jang Soo begins selling Bibi Roll on the streets, aiming for a business comeback. Su Ji confides in U Ri about her desire to release everything and fade away from the world. Doo Ri reaches out to Do Young to share news about an enticing part-time job opportunity.

Entries.Title: No Gain No Love
Entries.Description: Son Hae-yeong, a woman who is calculating by nature and hates to suffer losses. Kim Ji-uk, a civilian officer, neighborhood angel, perfect convenience store part-timer who hates causing trouble to people. After breaking up with her boyfriend to avoid losses, Hae-yeong makes a surprising offer to Ji-uk to win the in-house contest. What offer could she have made?

Episodes.Title: EP1
Episodes.Description: Son Hae-yeong, a woman who is calculating by nature and hates to suffer losses. Kim Ji-uk, a civilian officer, neighborhood angel, perfect convenience store part-timer who hates causing trouble to people. After breaking up with her boyfriend to avoid losses, Hae-yeong makes a surprising offer to Ji-uk to win the in-house contest. What offer could she have made?

Episodes.Title: EP2
Episodes.Description: Strange behavior follows after the proposal. Ji-uk rejects Hae-yeong's offer to be her fake husband without hesitation. Woo-jae shamelessly gaslights Hae-yeong after stealing her idea. Provoked by Woo-jae, Hae-yeong becomes increasingly desperate for a fake marriage and starts searching for a husband on a secondhand app. Will she find a fake husband?

Episodes.Title: EP3
Episodes.Description: This marriage is a failure! Shocked by Ji-uk's true looks, Hae-yeong vents her frustrations and becomes suspicious of him for knowing so much about her. Rumors about her handsome husband spark her coworkers' curiosity about her proposal story. Hae-yeong asks Ji-uk to propose to her, only to be treated like a weirdo again. Hae-yeong's wedding plan to erase all memories of her husband begins!

Episodes.Title: EP4
Episodes.Description: What are the odds of staying at the same hotel as your ex on your wedding day? Thanks to Woo-jae and Yi-lin, Hae-yeong and Ji-uk spend the night together. She teases him about his inexperience, and he mentions their kiss. They spend the night discussing gains and losses. Hae-yeong goes on the honeymoon alone while Ji-uk disappears without a word. Hae-yeong spots Ji-uk at an unexpected place!

Episodes.Title: EP5
Episodes.Description: The husband who had been missing and out of contact shows. And as a new recruit, no less. Hae-yeong is shocked to see Ji-uk as a new recruit at Kkulbee. Though he is apologetic, he is unable to share why he had to join the company. Meanwhile, fearing that their fake marriage will be exposed, Hae-yeong devises a plan to get rid of Ji-uk. However, this unexpectedly puts her in a tough spot.

Episodes.Title: EP6
Episodes.Description: Due to Ji-uk's unpredicted disclosure of his identity, he and Hae-yeong become the talk of the company. Hae-yeong is mistaken for pulling strings to get Ji-uk employed, while Ji-uk is upset that Hae-yeong speculates him to be the one who reported her for workplace harassment. Meanwhile, the mastermind behind Ji-uk's employment slowly becomes known. Will the true nepo baby's identity be revealed?

Episodes.Title: EP7
Episodes.Description: Waking up in the same bed as your ex-boyfriend and husband? Hae-yeong and Ji-uk wake up with no memory of the previous night after getting drunk. Woo-jae is upset at Yi-lin over a sudden personnel transfer, while Hae-yeong regrets getting married, prompting Ji-uk to offer a divorce. Meanwhile, Ja-yeon, worried about Gyu-hyun, visits the orphanage and almost runs into Ha-jun.

Episodes.Title: EP8
Episodes.Description: Hae-yeong and Ji-uk's long-awaited first kiss leads to a fight. What's the meaning behind Hae-yeong's kiss and Ji-uk's kiss? Ji-uk thinks of different ways to reconcile with the angry Hae-yeong. Who will emerge victorious in their first marital fight? Meanwhile, Hae-yeong visits the orphanage with the new business idea proposed by Ji-uk and faces the risk of Woo-jae discovering her secret.

Episodes.Title: EP9
Episodes.Description: Hae-yeong and Ji-uk reconcile. Ji-uk's place turns into chaos when Gyu-hyun visits him upon learning of his secret. Ji-uk decides to quit, only to be informed of an unexpected personnel change before he can hand in his resignation letter. However, Gyu-hyun's payback doesn't end there. Hae-yeong is bound to face losses in the fight between Gyu-hyun and his father. Will she fight back or back down?

Episodes.Title: EP10
Episodes.Description: Hae-yeong is shocked by Gyu-hyun's sudden appearance and Ja-yeon's confession. Gyu-hyun reveals Ji-uk and Ja-yeon's secrets, making Hae-yeong furious and driving them out of the house. Now homeless and uncertain, Ji-uk receives advice from Mr. Jang to live on his own terms. Ji-uk, the angel who has always lived for others, and Hae-yeong, who has discovered his secret. What will be their fate?

Episodes.Title: EP11
Episodes.Description: Hae-yeong storms out of the house after finding out about Ji-uk's secret, and Ji-uk is unable to hold her back. Ja-yeon feels heavy-hearted, thinking that Hae-yeong is angry because of her. Gyu-hyun and Ji-uk are equally shocked upon learning Hae-yeong and Ja-yeon's secret. Ji-uk struggles to find Hae-yeong, whose whereabouts are unknown, while Hae-yeong is clouded. Will he find her?

Episodes.Title: EP12
Episodes.Description: Hae-yeong is heartbroken over Eun-ok's sudden death. As she bids farewell with the help of her foster siblings, she begins to understand Eun-ok's life. Meanwhile, she feels heavy-hearted as Ji-uk promises not to leave her. Hae-yeong wishes for Ji-uk to live freely, while Ji-uk struggles to understand her. What will become of their complicated relationship?

Entries.Title: Queen of Tears
Entries.Description: Baek Hyun-woo and Hong Hae-in navigate a tense relationship, both at home and at work. But upon deciding his future, Hyun-woo pays a visit to his family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Baek Hyun-woo and Hong Hae-in navigate a tense relationship, both at home and at work. But upon deciding his future, Hyun-woo pays a visit to his family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After Hae-in reveals her grim news to Hyun-woo, he begins to treat her nicely. Meanwhile, Hae-in's old classmate returns to Korea and joins Queens Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hyun-woo discovers troubling evidence after saving Hae-in from a boar attack. Meanwhile, the two slowly find their long-lost feelings reigniting.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: As Yoon Eun-sung increasingly interlopes in Hae-in's life, Hyun-woo begins to feel jealous. Hae-in later shows up for Baek Du-gwan in his time of need.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: As Hyun-woo and Hae-in spend time in his hometown, they awkwardly navigate their complex feelings. Hae-in later receives bad news about her diagnosis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Hyun-woo unexpectedly shows up in Berlin to secure a treatment for Hae-in. Meanwhile in Korea, Hong Man-dae faces a crisis at his company.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Feeling betrayed by Hyun-woo, Hae-in pushes him away and becomes cold. Back in Korea, Hyun-woo begins to unravel a scheme against Hae-in's family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Despite being in a tense situation with Hae-in, Hyun-woo remains firm about staying in the company as his suspicions towards Eun-sung grow even stronger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Hae-in and her family go into hiding in Hyun-woo's hometown to figure out their next move. Eun-sung discovers the truth about Hae-in's health.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Eun-sung tracks down Hae-in, presenting her with an ultimatum. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo skillfully uses leverage to get Grace Ko on the Hong family's side.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Hae-in makes a shocking announcement at a press conference. Hyun-woo launches a risky evidence-collecting crusade to save Queens Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Hae-in's symptoms worsen as she suffers from hallucinations, which Eun-sung takes advantage of. Soon after, Hyun-woo finds himself captured and in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: The Hong family initiates a counterattack against Seul-hee and Eun-sung. Hyun-woo and Hae-in get to experience a freshly renewed life as 'newlyweds.'

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: After Hae-in shows hesitation about the surgery, her loved ones try to persuade her. Meanwhile, Eun-sung heads to Germany with a sinister plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: As Hae-in recovers from surgery, Eun-sung tries to stay right by her side. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo searches for evidence to vindicate himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Eun-sung executes his final plan to make Hae-in his own. As she tries to escape from his grasp with the help of Hyun-woo, will they finally find peace?

Entries.Title: Queen Woo
Entries.Description: As King Go Nam-mu is out on the battlefield during Goguryeo’s war against Han Dynasty, Queen Woo Hee and Prime Minister Eulpaso occupy the palace in his absence. However, many begin to covet the royal power, and conspiracies among them begin to emerge. The conflict escalates as the King does not yet have an heir to the throne.

Episodes.Title: The King Without an Heir
Episodes.Description: As King Go Nam-mu is out on the battlefield during Goguryeo’s war against Han Dynasty, Queen Woo Hee and Prime Minister Eulpaso occupy the palace in his absence. However, many begin to covet the royal power, and conspiracies among them begin to emerge. The conflict escalates as the King does not yet have an heir to the throne.

Episodes.Title: Death of the King
Episodes.Description: Upon returning from battle, King Go Nam-mu is poisoned and dies. The rumor of this unexpected event soon spreads, and those who seek power conspire. Meanwhile, Queen Woo Hee must protect herself without the King. So with the help of Moogol, she flees to meet the Third Prince.

Episodes.Title: The Empty Throne
Episodes.Description: As instructed, Queen Woo Hee visits the Third Prince to initiate the levirate marriage. However, upon seeing the consequences of his heinous actions, she concludes that the Third Prince is unworthy of any claim to power. Realizing the urgency, she escapes to avoid further complications. Meanwhile, those who have been biding their time sense that the moment has come to reclaim the throne they believe is rightfully theirs.

Episodes.Title: Assassins Attack Queen Woo
Episodes.Description: Word of the king's death travels in the ears of Yeon-bi of Jolbon. His passing gives rise to her ambitions of being the next queen. She travels fast to make the first move. Meanwhile, Queen Woo seeks refuge as groups of assassins close in on her.

Episodes.Title: The Chase
Episodes.Description: Eul Pa So continues to list potential suspects who might be responsible for His Majesty’s death, ultimately concluding that the spy must be someone who knows of the king's demise. Meanwhile, the White Tigers draw closer to Queen Woo, coming within an arm's length of capturing her.

Episodes.Title: The Fourth or the Fifth?
Episodes.Description: Queen Woo is confronted with a life-or-death choice that will shape the destiny of her entire family clan, all while being relentlessly pursued by White Tigers. In the heat of this peril, she senses that someone within her circle is covertly leaking her whereabouts. At the same time, Eul Pa So waits in the shadows, ready to act on the moves he expects her to make.

Episodes.Title: An Inescapable Attack
Episodes.Description: While preparing to leave, the Queen kills the Head Maid after finding out that the Head Maid betrayed her. Believing that Eul Pal So will come and help them with returning to the palace, the Queen takes the risk and goes to the ferry dock despite being chased by the White Tigers. Meanwhile, the Queen decides to make the Fourth Prince the new king through a levirate marriage.

Episodes.Title: The Reason to Fight
Episodes.Description: Bal Gi, Pae Eui, and their soldiers advance to start a war against Queen Woo. Recollecting how he was punished by Nam Mu for desiring the throne, Pae Eui reestablishes his determination to claim the throne. Although the oath of allegiance the five tribes made to King Chung Mo has been broken, Queen Woo still chooses to defend her palace. Then, reinforcements arrive to join hands with Queen Woo.

Entries.Title: Gangnam B-Side
Entries.Description: A girl in Gangnam disappears. Detective Kang, Broker Yoon and Prosecutor Min race to solve the case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A girl in Gangnam disappears. Detective Kang, Broker Yoon and Prosecutor Min race to solve the case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Dongwoo returns to Gangnam to find it changed as Gilho faces danger while chasing down the suspect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: The investigation takes a dark turn, leading Seojin to call Dongwoo. Gilho faces unsettling news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Gilho briefs Seojin and Dongwoo on the case. Together, the three head to the Colosseum.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jaehee heads over to meet Choi Hakgu to save Yeseo, while Dongwoo and Gilho try to rescue Jaehee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Seojin climbs the ranks with the help of Hakgu while Dongwoo becomes a chauffer and hunts for Yeseo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: As Gilho seeks revenge for Jaehee, he runs into Dongwoo who is hunting for clues to find Yeseo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Driven by love, revenge, and justice, each confront the cartel in their own way.

Entries.Title: Mr. Plankton
Entries.Description: Hae Jo, who runs an errand center, accepts Noh Yang-hui's request to kidnap her on her wedding day. Later, he unexpectedly runs into an old flame.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Hae Jo, who runs an errand center, accepts Noh Yang-hui's request to kidnap her on her wedding day. Later, he unexpectedly runs into an old flame.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Hae Jo sets out to find his sperm donor, the biological father he never knew. He crashes Jo Jae-mi's wedding and drags her along.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hae Jo recounts his first meeting with Jae-mi. While a huge fight breaks out at the sundae shop, Eo Heung and Wang Chil-seong's gang close in.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jae-mi makes a tough choice between Hae Jo and her devoted fiancé. Soon they head down to Busan, while a mysterious figure arrives to bail Heung out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Hae Jo spends meaningful time with Ko Jae-geun up in the mountains. Back in Seoul, Chil-seong corners Kkari and forces him to track down his old partner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Heung reflects on his relationship with Jae-mi. After Hae Jo steals a boat to escape Chil-seong, they end up stranded on a deserted island.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Shaken by the island ordeal, Hae Jo slips into a slump his friend Yang Bong-suk can't lift. Meanwhile, Heung does everything to stay by Jae-mi's side.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Afraid of hurting Jae-mi again, Hae Jo tries to push her away. Later, he takes on a new errand and meets a young girl looking for her long-lost brother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: After learning about Hae Jo's severe condition, Jae-mi is determined to help him find his biological father. But when she returns, he's gone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Now alone with Heung, Hae Jo reflects on his unfortunate life. After a tense reunion at Kkari's workplace, Hae Jo decides to confront his painful past.

Entries.Title: The Bequeathed
Entries.Description: At her unknown uncle’s funeral, Yoon Seo-ha meets Kim Young-ho, a man claiming to be her half brother. Meanwhile, detective Choi Sung-jun chases new leads.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: At her unknown uncle’s funeral, Yoon Seo-ha meets Kim Young-ho, a man claiming to be her half brother. Meanwhile, detective Choi Sung-jun chases new leads.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Seo-ha suspects Young-ho may have a hand in a recent tragic murder. An age-old conflict between chief detective Park Sang-min and Sung-jun surfaces.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: The police refuse to arrest Young-ho, forcing Seo-ha to ask a private investigator to look for evidence. Sung-jun dives into Young-ho's shamanic past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Young-ho receives an ominous warning about a family burial ground and runs after Seo-ha. Sang-min hastily orders a search of Young-ho's home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Seo-ha's attempts at intimidating Young-ho go awry. Sung-jun and Sang-min track down a stranger who may be connected to the killings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Confronted with the shocking truth about the burial ground, Seo-ha finds herself in peril — and she must devise a last-ditch effort to save herself.

Entries.Title: The 8 Show
Entries.Description: Badly in debt, a man hesitantly joins a mysterious show and meets seven other eclectic strangers. Their first goal? Figure out the rules.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Badly in debt, a man hesitantly joins a mysterious show and meets seven other eclectic strangers. Their first goal? Figure out the rules.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Realizing that an activity rewards them with time, the eight coordinate a plan. But soon, chaos erupts as their strategy doesn't last.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3

Through the case she took to be recognized as part of the Chayul family, she meets Gi-jun, her former lover from nine years ago. Gi-jun, who can’t stand seeing bad guys win, gives a piece of advice to Sa-ra, but she gets schemed by her husband, Yul-seong, and her mother-in-law.
