Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Sa-ra is a hot-shot divorce lawyer and the daughter-in-law of the owner of Korea’s top law firm, Chayul. Through the case she took to be recognized as part of the Chayul family, she meets Gi-jun, her former lover from nine years ago. Gi-jun, who can’t stand seeing bad guys win, gives a piece of advice to Sa-ra, but she gets schemed by her husband, Yul-seong, and her mother-in-law. She gets divorced in disguise and even ends up in prison. Sa-ra becomes an ex-convict from a lawyer overnight.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After Sa-ra gets released from prison, she returns to work as a divorce fixer and the team leader of Solution. One day, she takes the divorce case of a best-seller writer and Korea’s top anchor. The opposing counsel turns out to be Chayul. Sa-ra begins her solution service against her ex-husband, Yul-seong. Meanwhile, Prosecutor Dong Gi-jun focuses his attention on the Na Yu-mi suicide case. As he digs into it, he becomes aware that Yul-seong is deeply involved in the case. What’s the truth behind this case?

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Solution becomes whole when Gi Jun, an unconventional lawyer, joins the team. Their fearless solution and punishment for justice begin in earnest. They can't just sit back and let Jang Jae Gook go on with his one-man show. With Sa Ra's special solution, they punish the vicious husband. Their solution for this case is for the victims to join hands. Meanwhile, an unexpected client visits Solution, which astonishes Sa Ra.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ji In is facing the same kind of divorce that Sa Ra faced with Yul Seong. She asks Sa Ra to keep a secret that Yul Seong must not find out. Sa Ra seeks for a way to save Ji In in Solution's style. Sa Ra and Gi Jun feel mixed emotions while working together. They were apart for a long time, leading different lives, but both Sa Ra and Gi Jun still have the same traits that they used to find admirable in each other.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Yul Seong finally gets something on Ji In, and he begins a political show, using her. But Sa Ra can't bear to let this happen. She thinks giving up will only be her loss. She trains her mind and body with that spirit. An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth! She begins fighting him back with an even better political show. Sa Ra has messed up with Yul Seong big time. The evil ex, Yul Seong. It's best to avoid seeing him alone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: An influencer with a fancy career, Choi La Hee, visits SOLUTION to seek a divorce consultation. Gi Jun is surprised to see her. La Hee doesn't seem that desperate for a divorce, and all of her attention is on Gi Jun. Sa Ra takes notice of that and works her hunches. Their solution goes to her husband instead of Choi La Hee herself. It's SOLUTION's first time to give a divorce solution to the client's spouse. They provide the fanciest and most dramatic solution to La Hee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Yul Seong pushes things forward at full gallop to build a law school. To stop him, Sa Ra meets Kim Young A, the Hanjoo Party representative. But Young A consults her about an unexpected case. The SOLUTION team fights against the cosmic energy to stop Kim Young A's divorce. Gi Jun continues unraveling the story behind the Na Yu Mi case. He finally gets his hand on Professor Seo's phone and secures a critical piece of evidence. It turns out that the more they dig into this case, the more dangerous it gets for him and Sa Ra.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: SOLUTION's extraordinary plan to destroy Pastor Cheonji continues. Will Sa Ra be able to get Kim Young A and the children out of Cheonji Dongsan? Sa Ra also comes up with a plan to strike Yul Seong on the Taking Kim Young A Down project. Who will be the winner of this intense war, Sa Ra or Yul Seong? Yul Seong decides to approach Sa Ra in a new way and offers a shocking suggestion to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Sa Ra can tell her change of heart. While her feelings toward Gi Jun are growing stronger, she has to prepare for the death anniversary of her mother with him. Gi Jun finds out that Sa Ra's mother was the informant who had gone missing. Sa Ra finds out that her mother was the Na Yu Mi case's witness and that Na Yu Mi might've not killed herself. She must reveal the truth behind this case, and the keyman is the part-timer Bae So Hee who worked with her mom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Sa Ra goes back into Yul Seong's house despite everyone's opposition. She had already made up her mind, so no one could change her decision. They have no choice but to trust her decision. That's how the grand fraud show for Chayul begins. Once Sa Ra is in Chayul, she starts looking for the traces of the two cases. What kind of clue will she be able to find? A man who wears limited-edition sneakers was involved in both cases. The more they dig into him, the more confusing it becomes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: The truth behind Sa Ra’s mother’s death is revealed. Sa Ra comes up with a plan to make Yul Seong and Chairwoman Cha mistrust each other. Yul Seong gets arrested in the end, but he claims that Chairwoman Cha plotted everything. Meanwhile, Hui Jin reveals what Yul Seong did to Na Yu Mi in front of the investors for Chayul Town.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Ji In helps Sa Ra by handing over materials on the five-member society. Sa Ra also finds the ledger that Yul Seong kept hidden. Yul Seong kidnaps Sa Ra and threatens her to say that she faked the ledger. However, Gi Jun comes to her rescue, making Yul Seong pay for everything he’s done.

Episodes.Description: "I guess I like you, A-jung." Did A-jung really succeed in getting Ji-han on her side? Her mission to marry Do-han seems to be going well, but can she and Ji-han truly get along? Meanwhile, Do-han's ex approaches A-jung.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: I have a crush on Na A-jung?! Ji-han is troubled once he realizes his true feelings. Just seeing his brother and A-jung together hurts, and perhaps that's the real reason why Ji-han wants to stop their marriage. Meanwhile, A-jung and Do-han plan a meeting with their families, but A-jung feels uneasy about Ji-han's behavior toward her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Ji-han finally accepts A-jung and Do-han's marriage and is no longer in their way... But why does A-jung feel uneasy? Things become even more complicated when reporters gather around her home, forcing A-jung to flee to Do-han's house. But things start to get tense as the three begin to live together...

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ji-han finds out about Do-han’s secret, but rather than being shocked, he’s worried about A-jung. Ji-han wonders if A-jung knows the truth and decides to oppose their marriage once again. Ji-han's persistence confuses A-jung more than ever, but deep inside, she believes he might be able to save her from everything. Meanwhile, Do-han becomes tired of Ji-han's whims.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Ji-han and A-jung finally confirm their feelings for each other, but they still can't be completely honest. A love between a soon-to-be bride and her future brother-in-law... Will things really be okay?

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: It’s total chaos! All the lies A-jung, Ji-han, and Do-han have been telling each other are revealed. The three fall apart as they feel betrayed by each other. Just when they thought things couldn't get any worse, a scandal about the three breaks out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Ji-han gives up everything for A-jung. Neither LJ Group nor his grandfather’s acknowledgment are as important to him as her now. But A-jung feels pained to see him do so, and so does Do-han. The time has finally come for everyone to stop acting and be honest. Will they be able to protect each other?

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Is it coincidence or fate? A-jung and Ji-han reunite after a year, and their story begins anew.

Entries.Title: Nothing Uncovered
Entries.Description: Jung Won, as a reporter, excels at uncovering the guilty ones, and not only that, she possesses beauty and is married to a wealthy man. However, everything takes a dramatic turn when she encounters a dead body. To compound matters, a woman she barely knows alleges an affair with Jung Won's husband. The once-perfect facade of Jung Won's life begins to fracture further.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Jung Won, as a reporter, excels at uncovering the guilty ones, and not only that, she possesses beauty and is married to a wealthy man. However, everything takes a dramatic turn when she encounters a dead body. To compound matters, a woman she barely knows alleges an affair with Jung Won's husband. The once-perfect facade of Jung Won's life begins to fracture further.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jung Won can't seem to shake off the startling scene she unexpectedly encountered, prompting her to keep quiet about what she witnessed. She meticulously sifts through Woo Jae's belongings in search of anything dubious, yet comes up empty-handed. Nonetheless, the temporary relief fades quickly, and her suspicions about Woo Jae resurface. Meanwhile, Tae Heon stumbles upon a shocking discovery while reviewing security footage for a separate murder case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Woo Jae rejects any involvement in Cha Eun Sae’s death and asserts that he is not the father of her unborn child. He also brings up during the investigation that Eun Sae had a sugar daddy who had been looking after her. Meanwhile, Jung Won focuses on Cha Geum Sae, Eun Sae’s brother, as the main suspect and investigates him further.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: As Tae Heon unveils an evidence envelope containing a necklace, Jung Won is seized by overwhelming dread, her breath catching in her throat. She comes to the chilling realization that she is now under suspicion for the death of the woman entangled in an affair with her husband. Adding to her distress is the possibility of another woman deeply embedded in Woo Jae's life. Bewildered and frightened, Jung Won struggles to comprehend the gravity of the situation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: In a startling revelation, Jung Won uncovers that it was none other than Yoo Yoon Young who guided her to the scene of the murder. Meanwhile, Tae Heon meticulously pursues leads to unveil the culprit behind Cha Eun Sae's death. Jung Won delves into unlawfully recorded counseling sessions, unveiling the enigmatic persona of Lee Na Ri. As the truth becomes increasingly elusive with every turn, Jung Won ventures to Mueon City.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: At Mueon High School, Jung Won uncovers crucial information about Lee Na Ri, potentially linking the factory fire, Jin Myung Sook, Cha Eun Sae, and Mo Hyung Taek. Meanwhile, Tae Heon learns that Yoo Yoon Young’s car was captured by a speeding camera in Owol-dong on the day of the murder.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Upon confirming Yoon Young's alibi, Tae Heon hits a dead end, forcing him to reevaluate the investigation from scratch. Meanwhile, Woo Jae learns about Tae Heon and Jung Won's former romantic involvement and cautions Tae Heon against revisiting it. Jung Won, following an unpleasant three-way session involving Woo Jae and Yoon Young, realizes she's being followed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: She feels her existence is in serious jeopardy when Jung Won is kidnapped by an unidentified individual. The man's objective is to obtain her confession, specifically admitting to being the murderer. Meanwhile, while Yoon Young is asleep in a drunken state, Woo Jae investigates her belongings and discovers a photograph of Jung Won's necklace saved on one of her USB drives.

Entries.Title: LTNS
Entries.Description: Woo-jin and Samuel used to be deeply in love and very passionate about each other. However, after being married for a long time, the days of burning with sexual desire are long gone, and they become a sexless couple. One day, Samuel finds out his friend, Jung-soo, is having an affair. Woo-jin insists on telling Se-yeon about the truth.

Episodes.Title: Only Up to Two Loves Are Allowed
Episodes.Description: Woo-jin and Samuel used to be deeply in love and very passionate about each other. However, after being married for a long time, the days of burning with sexual desire are long gone, and they become a sexless couple. One day, Samuel finds out his friend, Jung-soo, is having an affair. Woo-jin insists on telling Se-yeon about the truth.

Episodes.Title: Cost of Dating
Episodes.Description: As life hits them hard, Samuel and Woo-jin decide to work together and blacklist the couples who are cheating on their partners for money. Woo-jin finds targets from the hotel she is working at, and Samuel puts a tail on them. Meanwhile, despite their financial difficulty, they spend the money they made on Samuel’s father’s birthday and Woo-jin’s niece’s academy fee.

Episodes.Title: The Real Kiss
Episodes.Description: Samuel and Woo Jin look for another target. An old man comes to Woo Jin's hotel and it seems like he is having an affair. Samuel and Woo Jin follow the couple to the mountains and the sea to gather evidence that they can use to blackmail the couple. However, the old man suggested that they meet at his company if they both wanted to get money from him.

Episodes.Title: No Exes Allowed
Episodes.Description: Samuel and Woo Jin are having a hard time finding a new target. One night, a couple gets into Samuel's cab, and it seems like they are having an affair. Samuel and Woo Jin try to maintain their relationship when they see the couple passionately making love. They think they have succeeded in robbing them of money. "But Samuel had an accident while running away.

Episodes.Title: Watching the Fire
Episodes.Description: Woo Jin goes to the hospital and Samuel is not in bed. It turns out that Samuel is with Min Soo, his neighbor and cleaning friend in the past. Woo Jin calls him and catches him lying. He decides to follow him to see what's going on.

Episodes.Title: Long Time No Sex
Episodes.Description: Woo Jin thinks about his relationship with Samuel and tries to figure out when and where everything started to go wrong. Feeling betrayed, he decides to blackmail the woman next door. Woo Jin interrogates Samuel, and Samuel tells him the secret he's been keeping. Woo Jin is confused, and that leads to big fight. What will this couple end up like?

Entries.Title: Marry My Husband
Entries.Description: Ji-won believed that Su-min would always have her back until she discovered that Su-min was having an affair with her husband. Ji-won, a terminally ill cancer patient, witnesses the two in bed discussing her insurance payout. She ends up not being able to live out the remaining days of her numbered life before she's killed... But then she suddenly wakes up, and it's 2013?!

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ji-won believed that Su-min would always have her back until she discovered that Su-min was having an affair with her husband. Ji-won, a terminally ill cancer patient, witnesses the two in bed discussing her insurance payout. She ends up not being able to live out the remaining days of her numbered life before she's killed... But then she suddenly wakes up, and it's 2013?!

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ji-won has gone back 10 years in time and learns that events will unfold as they are meant to according to the law of destiny. In an attempt to pass on her fate to Su-min, she tries to set up her future husband, Park Min-hwan, with her... However, Su-min's sly manipulation becomes more apparent to Ji-won, and now it's her turn to counterattack!

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yu Ji-hyuk had no connections with Ji-won in her previous life, but he is gradually becoming involved in her current life. Su-min invites Ji-won to a school reunion to resurrect the shameful memories of when she was ostracized in high school. Ji-won sees through Su-min's intentions, and with the help of her colleagues, she undergoes a transformation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ji-won attends an event with Ji-hyeok and meets someone who will be a future topic of discussion. Ji-hyuk becomes concerned as he observes Ji-won's transformation. After a heated encounter at the high school reunion, Su-min becomes even more obsessed with Ji-won. Meanwhile, as Ji-won tries to provoke Su-min with Min-hwan, she unexpectedly discovers a secret about Ji-hyuk during a work errand.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyuk reminisces about his first encounter with Ji-won eight years ago. His sole purpose in coming back is now Ji-won. Su-min manipulates Mr. Kim to steal Ji-won's proposal, while Ji-hyuk tries to assist Ji-won. However, due to misunderstandings stemming from his relationship with Hui-yeon, Ji-won ends up getting angry at Ji-hyuk instead.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyuk confesses his feelings to Ji-won, but she has no time to contemplate her own emotions for him. As Ji-won attempts to overcome her destiny and confront forces opposing the original direction of her fate, her name is ultimately omitted from the proposal. Ji-hyuk empowers Ji-won to take a stand and fight, while Ji-won recalls a future known only to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The two have discovered that they both traveled back in time! While Ji-won is thrilled to find a comrade, Ji-hyuk starts to avoid her. He suffers alone after learning of the cruel laws of time travel too late. Meanwhile, Ji-won goes on a picnic with Su-min and Min-hwan, managing to leave the two behind. On her way back, she runs into Ji-hyuk, who appears to have sorted out his thoughts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: During the company's autumn workshop, Ji-won and Su-min engage in a fierce battle of wits. It's the first time they confront each other so sincerely. Su-min becomes angry and attempts to cross the line to hurt Ji-won. Eventually, an incident occurs at a supermarket tasting event involving Min-hwan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: With Ji-hyuk's help, Min-hwan proposes to Ji-won. Ji-won spreads rumors at work to start a buzz. Su-min is upset and intentionally tries to turn Min-hwan's mother and Ji-won into enemies to ruin the engagement dinner. However, the night of the dinner arrives, and it's the day Ji-won has been waiting for.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Ji-won ruins the engagement dinner, leaving Min-hwan utterly embarrassed. Employees soon gossip that Ji-won and Min-hwan's engagement has been called off, and he's been cheating with Su-min. Su-min tries to cover it up, but because of her lies, the supermarket incident resurfaces. She's now caught in a crisis and ends up dropping the bomb.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: They finally kiss. Ji-won is going full power towards him, while he continually tries to hit the brakes. Eventually, he ends up opening up to Ji-won. On the other hand, Su-min and Min-hwan speed up the wedding due to an unexpected pregnancy, and Ji-won shows up with Ji-hyuk as her date, aiming to outshine the bride.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyuk's fiancée, Yu-ra, makes an appearance and creates a rift between Ji-hyuk and Ji-won. Moreover, Ji-won is surprised to hear about Ju-ran's stomach cancer. She is shocked to realize that her fate wasn't passed on to Su-min. Meanwhile, Su-min and Min-hwan, spending their newlywed days discontentedly, acquire information about Ji-hyuk that enrages them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: After an accident that was intended to harm Ji-won, Ji-hyuk gets injured instead and falls into a coma. Ji-won is scared that Ji-hyuk may never wake up. With everyone involved in the accident busy covering their tracks, Ji-won learns the truth behind the accident and seeks out Su-min to confront her memories from a distant past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Ji-hyuk regains consciousness and quietly trails the person involved in the accident that Yu-ra is trying to conceal. Meanwhile, Ji-won realizes that, in order to pass on her fate to Su-min, she must get Min-hwan to have an affair. Ji-won decides to become Min-hwan's secret lover, pretends to break up with Ji-hyuk, and approaches Min-hwan once more.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Su-min meets Yu-ra and presents compelling evidence, prompting Yu-ra to start finding a way to resolve the situation once and for all. Ji-won and Ji-hyuk initiate their final operations toward Min-hwan and Su-min, finally bringing about the night of destiny!

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: With Su-min's disappearance after Min-hwan's death, the fate intertwined with Ji-won finally dissolves. Ji-won receives a formal invitation to Chairman Yu Han-il's home and starts planning her future with Ji-hyuk. Just as they are about to attain their happiness, Su-min reappears to conclude the long-forged tragic fate.

Entries.Title: My Sweet Mobster
Entries.Description: Ji-hwan, the former boss of the Bulldog Gang, is now the CEO of Thirsty Deer Corporation, a company that specializes in making all sorts of charcuterie. Eun-ha tries her best to become more famous as a WeTuber called Ms. Mini, who creates online video content for kids. The two seem like they would never belong in the same world, but by chance, they keep running into each other.

Episodes.Title: The Ex-Con CEO and Ms. Mini
Episodes.Description: Ji-hwan, the former boss of the Bulldog Gang, is now the CEO of Thirsty Deer Corporation, a company that specializes in making all sorts of charcuterie. Eun-ha tries her best to become more famous as a WeTuber called Ms. Mini, who creates online video content for kids. The two seem like they would never belong in the same world, but by chance, they keep running into each other.

Episodes.Title: The Misunderstandings
Episodes.Description: Ji-hwan ends up in the hospital because of Eun-ha. She comes to apologise, but she is still afraid of what Ji-hwan and his employees might do to her. Meanwhile, Director Lee and Mr. Ma at Macaron Soft upload a maliciously edited video of Ji-hwan’s employees. This time, Ji-hwan misunderstands the situation and blames Eun-ha.

Episodes.Title: Life is Transitory
Episodes.Description: After being publicly shamed for promoting a milk brand that caused havoc to customers, Eun-ha takes down her channel to repent. Ji-hwan watches from the sidelines and desires to get close to her. Meanwhile, Ye-na offers Eun-ha a job cleaning house to humiliate her, but Eun-ha swallows her pride and takes it.

Episodes.Title: The Uninvited Guest
Episodes.Description: Eun-ha gets fired and kicked out of her apartment. Having nowhere to go, she wanders around in the rain. She goes to Ji-hwan’s house to return his coat and ends up staying there for the night. Ji-hwan goes to Yoon-taek’s house to look for him, and Eun-ha tags along to talk to his little sister. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo also heads to Yoon-taek’s house, only to run into Ji-hwan and Eun-ha.

Episodes.Title: Welcoming Party For Eun-ha
Episodes.Description: Hyun-woo tells Eun-ha who Ji-hwan really is, but she tries to defend Ji-hwan. Eun-ha runs into Hong-ki, who is on the run from Ji-hwan, but Hong-ki soon gets caught by the members of the Bulldog Gang. Meanwhile, Ji-hwan holds a welcoming party for Eun-ha, and Eun-ha invites someone over.

Episodes.Title: As If Nothing Happened
Episodes.Description: After having a drink last night, Eun-ha pretends that nothing happened between Ji-hwan and her. Ji-hwan seems quite proud and satisfied with his new nickname which Eun-ha gave. Meanwhile, Il-young and Mi-ho get doused with water when they walk down the street together. The members of the Bulldog Gang hurriedly head somewhere after getting an emergency call in the morning.

Episodes.Title: Resident Registration
Episodes.Description: Eun-ha and Ji-hwan are finally rescued from the cold storage, and Eun-ha gets hospitalised. Mi-ho runs into Il-young on her way to visit Eun-ha, and there goes an awkward moment between them. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo tries to help Eun-ha find her childhood friend from her neighbourhood.

Episodes.Title: Hyun-woo's Dream
Episodes.Description: Ji-hwan recalls the day he buried a box that a childhood friend gave him eight years ago and how he got involved in a fight at a hotel ten years ago. Ji-hwan soon leaves home alone to save Yoon-taek, who is kept hostage. Meanwhile, Hyun Woo receives a tip about the drug deal and witnesses Ji-hwan at the scene.

Episodes.Title: Finding A New Place
Episodes.Description: Hyun-woo says that he can tell Eun-ha who the Hyun-woo she's looking for is. Eun-ha announces that she plans to move out of Ji-hwan's house. She starts to go out to find a place she'll move in. Meanwhile, Ji-hwan hears that Eun-ha is on a blind date in the company building and becomes curious about the blind date.

Episodes.Title: Going On a Trip Together
Episodes.Description: The members of the Bulldog Gang take Eun-ha and Ji-hwan on a trip with the intention of helping them make up with each other. Eun-ha goes for a walk in the woods alone and Ji-hwan starts to worry about her. Meanwhile, Mi-ho does a pregnancy test herself, but she ends up losing the test stick.

Episodes.Title: Eun-ha’s New Channel
Episodes.Description: Eun-ha creates her new channel for kids online again, and she soon gets comments from two passionate fans. Il-young comes to visit Mi-ho's hair salon to tell her how he feels. Meanwhile, Ji-hwan witnesses an uninvited guest chatting with Man-ho and Jae-soo in his place. At a bakery, Dong-hui runs into someone who reminds him of his past that he doesn't wish to recall.

Episodes.Title: Ji-hwan On His Childhood
Episodes.Description: Hyun-woo is furious that he's forced to stop investigating the drug case involving Go Yang-hee. Il-young recalls how he ended up spending the night at Mi-ho's house. Ji-hwan tells Eun-ha about his childhood and relationship with Seo Tae-pyeong. Dong-hui can't stop thinking about his time with Seung-hui.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: Eun-ha is convinced that she has finally found Hyun-woo whom she has been desperately looking for. Dong-hui is intimidated by a man who causes a commotion in the company and recalls the old days he spent with Seung-hui. Mi-ho finds out that Il-young knew about her secret all along. Meanwhile, Tae-pyung makes an offer to Ji-hwan.

Episodes.Title: The Inescapable Swamp
Episodes.Description: Il-young announces to the gang that he’ll get married to Mi-ho and that she’s pregnant with his child. Seo Tae-pyeong barges into Ji-hwan’s company with his men and claims to settle the debt. Fearing Seo Tae-pyeong’s retribution, the company’s board members resign. Meanwhile, Eun-ha gets attacked by Go Yang-hee while wrapping up the offline event.

Episodes.Title: Risky Love
Episodes.Description: Ji-hwan faces a significant dilemma when he realises that, despite his strong desire to be with Eun-ha, his presence might actually put her safety at risk. On the other hand, Eun-ha is unconcerned about the dangers that might follow Ji-hwan and simply wants to be with him. Ji-hwan feels he needs to complete one last task before making any decisions about Eun-ha, but it might already be too late.

Episodes.Title: Unconscious Subscriber
Episodes.Description: Ji-hwan is critically injured while attempting to rescue his father and is now in a coma due to severe bleeding. The only option is to wait for him to regain consciousness. Eun-ha remains by his side, caring for him and hoping for his recovery. Meanwhile, Tae-pyung, who has been arrested, refuses to confess voluntarily, though he does show some emotional response upon learning about his son's condition.

Entries.Title: Goodbye Earth
Entries.Description: Traumatized by a tragedy that keeps haunting her, Jin Se-kyung vows to keep her loved ones safe and plots revenge against the perpetrators.

Episodes.Title: Football, Bloody Hell!
Episodes.Description: Traumatized by a tragedy that keeps haunting her, Jin Se-kyung vows to keep her loved ones safe and plots revenge against the perpetrators.

Episodes.Title: Love Is Back
Episodes.Description: Suspecting Se-kyung's role in the latest murder, Kang In-a gives her a warning. But as Se-kyung plans her next move, a surprising visitor greets her.

Episodes.Title: I Have Butterflies...
Episodes.Description: Ha Yun-sang's friends celebrate his sudden return, despite the mystery surrounding it. Meanwhile, Se-kyung realizes she's being watched.

Episodes.Title: Felix Culpa
Episodes.Description: Se-kyung confides in In-a about the ominous threats she's been receiving. The two later embark on a dangerous mission to confront the criminal.

Episodes.Title: The Girl with a Cat
Episodes.Description: Despite her recent win, Se-kyung still worries that the threat isn't over. Yun-sang receives an enigmatic proposal involving important missing figures.

Episodes.Title: Much Ado About Nothing
Episodes.Description: Disorder during the joint memorial Mass leads to chaos at the church, increasing criticism and scrutiny into the whereabouts of Father Baek.

Episodes.Title: Arirang; Gone, but Not Forgotten
Episodes.Description: Se-kyung discovers more about a mysterious training center, and pleads with In-a to investigate it. They soon find darker secrets lie within the building.

Episodes.Title: Dum Spiro Spero
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of the raid, the group encounters pushback from authorities — but they uncover more disturbing details about Father Baek's activities.

Episodes.Title: Silver Lining
Episodes.Description: Se-kyung and Yun-sang finally confront Father Baek, who in turn leaves them with a choice, forcing Se-kyung to ask Yun-sang an impossible question.

Episodes.Title: Exodus, Eclipsed
Episodes.Description: On the day of the evacuation, Se-kyung and her friends coordinate a plot to get the children to safety. But pandemonium ensues as the plane approaches.

Episodes.Title: Last Christmas
Episodes.Description: Accepting the fate of the asteroid, everyone tries to carry on with their lives. But the harsh and grim realities of their last days set in.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye Earth
Episodes.Description: With less than 20 days left, survivors solemnly brace for the asteroid. However, Se-kyung remains steadfast in her mission to protect the children.

Entries.Title: High School Return of a Gangster
Entries.Description: Deuk Pal is about to become the boss of the Chilsung Gang. While mulling over giving up his dream of going to university, he tries to save Yi Heon from jumping off a bridge. Unfortunately, Deuk Pal loses his life but takes over Yi Heon's body. He learns of Yi Heon's misfortunes and resolves to avenge his suffering as a victim of bullying.

Episodes.Title: Deuk Pal Goes to High School
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal is about to become the boss of the Chilsung Gang. While mulling over giving up his dream of going to university, he tries to save Yi Heon from jumping off a bridge. Unfortunately, Deuk Pal loses his life but takes over Yi Heon's body. He learns of Yi Heon's misfortunes and resolves to avenge his suffering as a victim of bullying.

Episodes.Title: You Are Not Song Yi Heon
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal, now inhabiting Yi Heon’s body, arouses suspicion from Se Kyung due to his noticeable deviation from his usual self. Despite Deuk Pal's attempts to mimic Yi Heon's behaviour, the other kids begin to question the sudden change in him. Particularly with Jae Min persisting in ridiculing Yi Heon, Deuk Pal plots a subtle revenge for him.

Episodes.Title: Deuk Pal Takes Charge
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal proves he can fight in Yi Heon's body and gains control over Jae Min and his underlings. The kids at school can't believe how different Yi Heon is and are shocked. Se Kyung gets DNA testing done to see if Yi Heon is still the Yi Heon he knows, and Deuk Pal focuses on his studies and setting things right for Yi Heon. Meanwhile, Deuk Pal learns about what happened the night before Yi Heon died from Se Kyung as they become closer.

Episodes.Title: Yi Heon's Mom Kidnapping
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal and Se Kyung save Yi Heon's mom from getting kidnapped. Luckily, she was unharmed. Although he has a hunch about who might be responsible, Deuk Pal vows to protect Yi Heon and his family without the police involved. Meanwhile, Jae Min approaches Deuk Pal to find out if the police are looking for him, but Se Kyung confronts him about his involvement in the attempted kidnapping.

Episodes.Title: Yi Heon Warns Dong Soo
Episodes.Description: Se Kyung witnesses Yi Heon getting abducted but can't do anything about it because he remembers Yi Heon telling him not to call the police about anything. He asks Jae Min for help, but Jae Min cowards out. Meanwhile, Yi Heon deals with the gangsters and tells them things that shock them.

Episodes.Title: Reach Out
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal and Se Kyung go to see the ocean and have a day off. Se Kyung talks about his father who’s been trying to control him since young and how it made him stressed and suffocating. Se Kyung’s father comes to school and calls for the violence committee. Meanwhile, Deuk Pal finds out that Yi Heon’s mother has been taking addictive medicine.

Episodes.Title: This Is Your Last Chance
Episodes.Description: Deuk Pal found out that the school bullies reported Yi Heon for school violence. He orders Dong Soo and the gang to get Lee Mi Kyung since she is the one behind them. Byung Chul tells Jae Min to join him and report Yi Heon as well. Jae Min feels guilty about falsely charging Yi Heon, but he's also scared that he might end up going to the juvie if the truth is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Jae Min confesses to bullying Yi Heon and other kids at school. Thanks to Jae Min, the charges are dropped, but Deuk Pal still needs to find Mi Kyung so that she won't come back to threaten Yi Heon and his mother again. He decides to meet Chairman Bae and set everything right. Meanwhile, Yi Heon's soul returns and tells Deuk Pal that he does not have much time left.

Entries.Title: Jeongnyeon: The Star is Born
Entries.Description: Jeong-nyeon is a gifted singer. Desperate to escape her life, she discovers the world of gukgeuk.

Episodes.Title: Act 1
Episodes.Description: Jeong-nyeon is a gifted singer. Desperate to escape her life, she discovers the world of gukgeuk.

Episodes.Title: Act 2
Episodes.Description: Jeong-nyeon is accepted into Maeran Gukgeukdan and must now prove she deserves to stay.

Episodes.Title: Act 3
Episodes.Description: As she struggles to play a character, Jeong-nyeon faces a sudden crisis during her first performance.

Episodes.Title: Act 4
